defects.defect: Copy and Reset model two different objects. `copyAsJson` serialises the entire reactive proxy, exporting members no slider drives and one member the defaults object was deliberately built to exclude.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:88-90. Measured payloads: `/#/blob` copy keys `geometry,satellites,membrane,color,surface,interaction,morphT,quality,tempo` with `morphT: 1`, `quality: "full"` and `color.paletteStops` — none of which any of the 31 sliders drives (BlobPane.vue:8-9 calls paletteStops 'the live picker-palette feed … not a slider'). `/#/atmosphere` copy includes `"seed": "lab(92% 88.8 20)"` while Reset excludes it by design (aurora-atoms.ts:17-20). So Reset excludes `seed` and Copy includes it; Reset clobbers `paletteStops` and Copy exports it.
defects.mechanism: stringly-typed reflection layer — Copy guesses 'the whole object'
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/atmosphere with clipboard intercepted: click `Copy JSON`, click `Reset`, click `Copy JSON`. Both payloads carry `seed`, which `DEFAULT_AURORA_ATOMS` omits precisely so Reset will not disturb the picker coupling. Pasting the export back as a preset freezes the seed and severs that coupling.
defects.proposedCure: One projection function over `sections[].defs[].key` consumed by both buttons; Copy emits exactly the declared surface. The disagreement becomes unrepresentable.

defects.defect: The dot-path helpers are unguarded on both sides: `read()` casts a possibly-`undefined` walk result `as number` and `fmt()` throws inside the render function; `writePath()` walks intermediates with no null check and throws inside the `@update:model-value` handler.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:57-64 (readPath), :66-73 (writePath), :76-78 (read, `as number`), :84-86 (fmt), :141/:147 (call sites), :151 (handler). Executed against the shipped source text (scratchpad csp3-p4.mjs brace-matches the functions out of the .vue and strips only type annotations): `fmt(undefined) -> TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`; `writePath({}, 'zones.count', 3) -> TypeError: Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'count')`; same for `{zones: undefined}` and for a 3-deep missing intermediate.
defects.mechanism: stringly-typed reflection layer — `read` guesses 'it will resolve', `writePath` guesses 'the intermediates exist'
defects.reproduction: node harness executing the component's own function text (csp3-p4.mjs). Read-side unmount was demonstrated by injection in pass 1. LIVE reachability is a labelled HYPOTHESIS: `AuroraAtoms.zones` is declared optional and the pane addresses `zones.count` (AuroraPane.vue:103), but DEFAULT_AURORA_ATOMS:56 always supplies it and setArrangement always rewrites it whole, so the branch is unreached today.
defects.proposedCure: Type the domain instead of guarding it: make `sections` the declared key domain and resolve each `def.key` once against the config's type, so an unresolvable path is a compile error rather than a runtime walk. If the generic must stay, `read` returns `number | undefined` and the row renders an explicit unresolved state; `writePath` refuses to create or traverse missing intermediates.

defects.defect: Two pairs of sliders share one accessible name. 31 sliders expose only 29 distinct names, and the section header that disambiguates them visually is not exposed programmatically.
defects.evidence: Measured on http://localhost:9000/#/blob: `{ total: 31, distinct: 29, duplicates: [["Noise Freq",2],["Noise Speed",2]] }`. Sources: BlobPane.vue:71-72 (`membrane.noiseFreq`→'Noise Freq', `membrane.noiseSpeed`→'Noise Speed') and BlobPane.vue:83-84 (`color.colorNoiseFreq`→'Noise Freq', `color.colorNoiseSpeed`→'Noise Speed'). `def.label` is the slider's only accessible name (ConfigSliderPane.vue:145). Ranges differ (0.5–10.0 vs 0.5–8.0; 0–0.5 vs 0–0.3).
defects.mechanism: compositional: non-programmatic sectioning (D-6b) plus consumer labels that are only unique within a section
defects.reproduction: Navigate to /#/blob, enumerate `.config-console .configurator-row label` textContent and count distinct values: 31 rows, 29 distinct. In a screen reader's controls list the four rows read as two indistinguishable pairs.
defects.proposedCure: Give the section wrapper (ConfigSliderPane.vue:124-127) a real `role="group"` + `aria-labelledby` pointing at an id'd section title — this cures D-6b in the same edit and makes the labels unique by context, rather than renaming knobs in the consumer.

defects.defect: The live readout is orphaned twice over: the row's `<label>` has no `for`/`id` and wraps nothing, the readout `<span>` has no `id`/`aria-live`/`aria-describedby` link, and `aria-valuetext` is absent from all 31 thumbs — so the sighted user reads '0.220' while assistive tech announces the raw float 0.22.
defects.evidence: Captured row DOM: `0.220`. Census: `rows 31 · rootsWithAriaLabel 31 · thumbsWithAriaLabel 31 · thumbsWithValueText 0 · labelsWithFor 0 · anyAriaLiveInPane 0 · readoutInsideLabel false`; thumb sample `aria-valuenow "0.22" / aria-labelledby null / aria-describedby null / aria-valuetext null`. The producer names the correct primitive in its own typing — node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/configurator/ConfiguratorRow.vue.d.ts: 'ConfiguratorRow … No a11y for/id wiring. … use LabeledField directly for an accessible form control'. The demo's own cure exists and is unconsumed: demo/picker/controls/ComponentSliders/composables/useSliderAnnouncements.ts:41-42 sets `aria-valuetext` for the FIRST slider population.
defects.mechanism: producer and demo affordances thrown away — the wrong primitive reached for, the right one one import away
defects.reproduction: Navigate to /#/blob and query `.config-console .configurator-row`: 0 of 31 labels carry `for`, 0 of 31 thumbs carry `aria-valuetext`, 0 aria-live regions exist in the pane.
defects.proposedCure: Swap `ConfiguratorRow` for the producer's `LabeledField` (dist/components/labeled-field/) for the label/control association, and consume the demo's own `useSliderAnnouncements` to set `aria-valuetext` on the second population as it already does on the first.

defects.defect: Seven visual sections with zero programmatic grouping — no `role="group"`, no heading elements, no `aria-labelledby`.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:128-130 renders a bare `<span class="config-section-title">`. Measured live: `{ visualSections: 7, groupRoles: 0, headingsInPane: 0, rolesOnSectionWrappers: [{hdrRole:null, parentRole:null, parentLabelledBy:null, id:null} x7] }`.
defects.mechanism: comments/markup asserting structure the accessibility tree never receives
defects.reproduction: Navigate to /#/blob; `document.querySelectorAll('.config-console [role="group"], .config-console fieldset').length === 0` while `.config-section-header` count is 7.
defects.proposedCure: `role="group"` + `aria-labelledby` on the existing section wrapper, with an `id` on the title span. One attribute pair; also cures N-2.

defects.defect: `variant="spectrum"` is declared and then overridden away: the producer recipe zeroes the range fill for that variant and the demo flattens the track, leaving 31 controls whose only value affordance is a 12px thumb.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:146 asks for the variant; :202 re-inks the track. Measured across all 31: `trackBg ["oklch(0.447121 0.00386159 34.63)"]`, `trackImg ["none"]`, `rangeBg ["rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"]`. Producer recipe: `.glass-slider[data-variant=spectrum] .slider-range{background:0 0}`. Visual control in one frame: docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/blob.png — four true spectrum sliders (picker, left) beside 31 identical charcoal slabs (right).
defects.mechanism: producer affordance requested and then defeated by the consumer's own override
defects.reproduction: Navigate to /#/blob and read computed styles of `.config-console .slider-track` / `.slider-range`: no gradient, no fill split, uniform across all 31 rows.
defects.proposedCure: Stop asking for the variant whose recipe removes the fill and shrinks the thumb to 12px. Use the default slider variant so the filled/unfilled split reads, or relay a spectrum-with-fill variant to glass-ui rather than patching the track demo-side.

defects.defect: `copyAsJson` discards the clipboard `CopyResult`; the button is silent on success and on both named failure modes.

defects.reproduction: Click `Copy JSON` on /#/blob with clipboard permission denied or in a non-secure context: no visual state change, no announcement, no console signal — the user cannot distinguish success from failure.

defects.defect: 12x24px slider thumbs on every measured matrix — 31 of the 39 tap-target defects on the worst route in the entire visual matrix.
defects.evidence: Measured: `thumbW [12], thumbH [24], smallTapTargets 31` across all 31 config sliders at 1440x900. REPORT arithmetic closes exactly against the REPORT's own control: REPORT.md:41 `safari-desktop-light /#/blob: 39` minus REPORT.md:71 `safari-mobile-light /#/blob: 8` (same route, pane not mounted — bodyTextLength 69) = 31, this component's slider count. `/#/atmosphere`: 7 − 4 = 3.

defects.reproduction: Navigate to /#/blob at 1440x900; every `.slider-thumb` measures 12x24 CSS px, below the 24px WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 target-size minimum in the inline axis.
defects.proposedCure: Demo half is D-3 (stop requesting the variant whose thumb recipe is the 12px one). The remaining half is a glass-ui relay: the coarse-pointer utility grows the slider ROOT (`[data-control-target] { min-inline-size: var(--touch-target, 2.75rem) }`), never the thumb.

defects.defect: The app's SECOND slider population has no reka-ui pointer-capture-cancel recovery of its own; its only net is a document-level listener owned by, and lifecycle-bound to, an unrelated component (the picker's ComponentSliders).
defects.evidence: reka SliderImpl.js has exactly three pointer handlers — onPointerdown (setPointerCapture), onPointermove, onPointerup (releasePointerCapture + emits slideEnd) — and NO pointercancel handler, so `slideEnd` is never emitted on a cancelled drag. glass-ui adds none: the per-Slider window listener captured by a monkeypatched `window.addEventListener` with stack `at setup (slider-DzqeQmMu-…:835:3)` has source `function I() { m.value &&= !1; }` — a press-flag clear, not capture recovery. CDP `DOMDebugger.getEventListeners(document)` on /#/blob returns exactly ONE pointercancel listener, from demo/picker/controls/ComponentSliders/composables/useSliderTouchGates.ts (whose own header at :8-9 calls itself 'the iOS Safari pointer-capture leak recovery'), torn down in its `onUnmounted` at :126-130. Listener types on the first config slider root: `{keydown:1, pointerdown:3, pointermove:1, pointerup:1, touchstart:2, touchmove:1, touchend:1}` — no pointercancel, no lostpointercapture. Slider census on the route: `allGlassSliders 35, configSliders 31` (the other four are L/A/B/ALPHA channel).
defects.mechanism: a named local hazard (repo record: 'reka-ui slider pointer-capture leaks needing pointercancel/lostpointercapture recovery') left uncovered; correctness depends on a sibling component's lifecycle with no declaration anywhere
defects.reproduction: ABSENCE is measured (CDP listener census above). The LEAK ITSELF IS A LABELLED HYPOTHESIS: the WebKit capture-retention bug the composable was written for cannot be reproduced in Chromium, and the picker happens to be co-mounted on both of this pane's routes, so the document net currently covers it by adjacency.
defects.proposedCure: Lift `useSliderTouchGates`' document-level force-release out of ComponentSliders into a boot-scope install (it is already a standalone composable keyed on `document`), so both slider populations inherit it by construction instead of by adjacency.

defects.defect: `writePath` is an unguarded dot-path writer: `__proto__` and `constructor.prototype` segments walk straight through, polluting `Object.prototype` for the whole page.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:66-73 — no `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` guard, no `Object.hasOwn` check. Executed against the shipped source text (scratchpad csp3-p4.mjs): `writePath({}, '__proto__.polluted', 1)` returns `{"own": [], "proto": 1}` — the target gains NO own property and `Object.prototype.polluted === 1`. `writePath({}, 'constructor.prototype.x', 1)` sets `{}.x === 1`.
defects.mechanism: stringly-typed reflection layer applied to caller-supplied data with no key validation
defects.reproduction: node harness executing the component's own function text. LATENT: every `def.key` today is a literal authored in BlobPane.vue:58-117 / AuroraPane.vue:101-103 and constrained by BlobPane's `NumericAtomPath` mapped type (:36-48), so there is no live reachability. But `sections` is a PROP on a component that advertises itself as generic, and the type that saves it lives in one consumer, not in the component.
defects.proposedCure: Same transposition as D-1: resolve writes against the declared `sections` key domain rather than walking arbitrary strings. If the generic walk survives, reject any segment in {`__proto__`,`constructor`,`prototype`} and require `Object.hasOwn` on each intermediate.

defects.defect: Two of the three most-argued CSS cures in this file are provably inert: the `clamp()` 'ONE RHYTHM SOURCE' min-block-size never binds, and the coarse-pointer `::before` hit extension adds zero.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:215-217 sets `min-block-size: clamp(2rem, 7cqi, 2.625rem)` (32–42px). Measured natural row heights: 61px at 1440 desktop (pass 1), 77.6px at 430 coarse (pass 2), and pass 3 at 320x700 on /#/atmosphere: `rowH [58,58,58]` with `rowMinBlock "32px"` — inert on all three matrices ever measured. :218-230's `::before` was ablated in pass 2 (removing it changes the box by 0px; `max(100%, 2.75rem)` = `max(44px,44px)`), and CDP `CSS.getMatchedStylesForNode` attributed the actual 44px to a producer utility already in effect app-wide (`[data-control-target] { min-block-size: var(--touch-target, 2.75rem) }`, dist/styles/utilities/responsive.css).
defects.mechanism: comments asserting cures the measurements refute; per-instance `:deep()` overrides of a design-system root
defects.reproduction: Navigate to /#/atmosphere at 320x700 and read `getComputedStyle(row).minBlockSize` ('32px') against `row.getBoundingClientRect().height` (58).
defects.proposedCure: Delete :215-217 and :218-230. The producer utility already supplies the coarse-pointer floor and the rows already size themselves.

defects.defect: Hand-rolled copy/reset/clone where the producer ships a typed configurator state machine one import away.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:88-94 is a bare `JSON.stringify` plus a shallow `Object.assign(config, structuredClone(defaults))`. `useConfiguratorState` is present in the consumed dist (node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/configurator.js, configurator-M5OaIlJd.js) and never imported; the producer's own reset is a full delete-then-assign replace with a try/caught clone and a diagnostic. `ConfiguratorRow.canReset` (per-row reset affordance, per ConfiguratorRow.vue.d.ts) is likewise unused.
defects.mechanism: producer affordances thrown away
defects.reproduction: grep the component for `useConfiguratorState` / `canReset`: zero hits; grep the dist: present and exported.
defects.proposedCure: Adopt `useConfiguratorState<T>` with its clone hook; it holds the key domain, which is the same cure D-1 and D-14 need.

defects.defect: Vacuous gate — no test exercises any behaviour of this component. Six mutations that delete its purpose all stay green, and the one automated oracle that touches it visits one row of one route.
defects.evidence: `ls -R demo/test` → export/byte-exact.test.ts, glass/aurora-bracket.test.ts, glass/aurora-motion.test.ts (the latter two assert DEFAULT_AURORA_ATOMS constants and never import the pane). `grep -rn "ConfigSliderPane|BlobPane|AuroraPane|config-console" test e2e demo/test` → exactly two colour-contrast oracles, e2e/smoke/oracles/o18-contrast-census.spec.ts:924 and :1161; o7-card-census.spec.ts:38-42 explicitly excludes the pane. The o18 config leg does `await page.goto("/#/atmosphere")` (:928) and settles on `.first()` of each selector. Neither oracle moves a slider, presses a button, or reads a value.
defects.mechanism: no behavioural coverage, so every family-3 divergence accumulated across two waves unnoticed
defects.reproduction: Green-staying mutations: M1 `update(){}` (34 sliders read-only); M2 `resetDefaults(){}`; M3 `copyAsJson(){}`; M4 `fmt(){return "0"}`; M5 delete `:aria-label` (:145 — 31 sliders lose their only name); M6 `writePath(o,p,v){ o[p]=v }` — deletes dot-path addressing entirely, the component's whole reason for existing, and BlobPane's NumericAtomPath mapped type still typechecks because it constrains `def.key`, not `writePath`. The 31-row /#/blob population is never entered by any gate at all.
defects.proposedCure: Seven vitest mounts: dot-path round-trip flat and nested (M1, M6); resetDefaults preserving a declared live key at depth 2 (D-1); the copy payload equalling the declared projection (D-14); `fmt` at {0,-0,NaN,Infinity,undefined} and at each declared step (D-15, D-5); `writePath` refusing `__proto__` (N-1); one distinct accessible name per row (N-2). Land this FIRST — it makes the next inert cure impossible to ship.

defects.defect: `fmt()` formats by value shape and never consults the declared `step`, so precision and glyph width change as the value moves.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:84-86 `Number.isInteger(v) ? String(v) : v.toFixed(3)`; `SliderDef.step` declared at :31 and never read. Measured live readouts on /#/blob: `Body Radius=0.220 Satellites=3 Sat Radius=0.082 Orbit Radius=0.170 Eccentricity=0.050 Smooth K=0.050` — '3' in a column of three-decimal strings. Executed: `fmt(0) -> "0"`, `fmt(-0) -> "0"`, `fmt(0.005) -> "0.005"`, `fmt(2500) -> "2500"`.
defects.mechanism: a heuristic standing in for a declared property
defects.reproduction: Drag any knob whose domain contains 0 (color.satShift, color.brightnessShift, membrane.warpAmp, membrane.noiseAmp, membrane.pulseAmp, interaction.pointerAttraction): -0.005 → 0 → 0.005 renders 6 → 1 → 5 glyphs inside a `truncate` inline row. `fmt(-0)` is indistinguishable from `fmt(0)`.
defects.proposedCure: `v.toFixed(Math.max(0, -Math.floor(Math.log10(def.step))))`. One line; deletes the heuristic rather than tuning it, and makes readout width constant across each knob's domain.

defects.defect: `.pane-scroll-fade` is applied to an inner div rather than the Card root, contradicting the class's own one-home contract, and the 'fade mask' the comment attributes to it does not exist.
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:104-106 — comment 'The scroll region owns the fade mask + overflow' above `<div class="pane-scroll-fade …">`. Measured on the live element: `containOnScroller "content"`, `maskOnScroller "none"`. The class body is entirely `.pane-scroll-fade { contain: layout style paint; scroll-timeline: --pane-scroll block; }` (demo/shared/ui/PaneHeader.vue unscoped block); `grep -rn "pane-scroll-fade" node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist` → nothing. That same doc block states the class 'lives on the ROOT element of each pane Card (9 sibling panes: …/ConfigSlider)'; measured across siblings — GradientPane.vue:20, MixPane.vue:62, ExtractPane.vue:5, AboutPane.vue:4, BrowsePane.vue:2, GeneratePane.vue:31 — 6/6 put it on `<Card>`; this pane does not, and gives the Card `overflow-hidden` (:101) instead.
defects.mechanism: comments asserting cures the measurements refute, plus a silent divergence from a declared one-home contract
defects.reproduction: Navigate to /#/blob and read `getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.pane-scroll-fade')).maskImage` → 'none'; compare the class's host element against the six sibling panes.
defects.proposedCure: Either move the class to the Card root as the contract states (and let the Card own the scroll), or amend the contract in PaneHeader.vue to admit the inner-host form. defects.defect: Reduced motion does not resolve to the final state — pass-1's proved negative ("Motion / prefers-reduced-motion — SOUND") is falsified by measurement

result.axis: CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownership, dependency direction, public surface) for demo/scenes/about/ColorNutritionLabel.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id claude-opus-5[1m]; the tier declared at spawn, not inherited
result.strongestDefect: L-2 — three legal CSS colors blank the entire application (#app has zero children). The demo's library-boundary adapter (picker-color.ts valueOrThrow / channelNumber) aliases `PickerColor = AnyColor` yet is partial over it and throws on the `"none"` channel sentinel that ARCHITECTURE.md:84 makes part of the final object model and ARCHITECTURE.md:217 requires the library to EMIT for powerless hue. `http://localhost:9000/#/about?space=oklch&color=oklch(0.6 0 none)` → `pageerror: Missing oklch.h`, bodyLen 0, rootChildren 0. Structural root is L-3: the channel/range fact has five declarations across two packages and no owner, because /color publishes neither SPACE_SCHEMA nor SPACE_IDS.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. (Clean sub-axes, proven positively, are recorded in report §2: zero deep imports of the library — `grep -rn "@src\|value.js/src\|../../../src/" demo` returns nothing and all five demo specifiers are package.json#exports keys, generated as vite aliases FROM the export map; verbatimModuleSyntax satisfied at ColorNutritionLabel.vue:182-183; no cross-feature internal import; ink.ts composes @mkbabb/value.js/color rather than re-implementing any color math; none of the named historical duplication suspects touch this component; no animation deleted.)

defects.defect: The demo's library-boundary adapter converts the library's failure-explicit Result protocol into uncaught throws, and is partial over the very type it claims to alias — three legal CSS colors blank the whole SPA.
defects.evidence: demo/color-session/picker-color.ts:104-107 (valueOrThrow), :152-158 (channelNumber throws `Missing ${space}.${key}`), :36 (`export type PickerColor = AnyColor`); demo/color-session/ink.ts:45-49 (throws on L==="none"). Live: `http://localhost:9000/#/about?space=oklch&color=oklch(0.6 0 none)` → {"bodyLen":0,"rootChildren":0}, errors=["pageerror: Missing oklch.h"]; `?color=oklch(none 0.1 200)` on BOTH /#/ and /#/about → pageerror: color_missing_channel, rootChildren 0; valid control `oklch(0.6 0.1 200)` → bodyLen 1905, rootChildren 6, no errors. Contract: docs/tranches/V/ARCHITECTURE.md:84 (Channel = number | "none", the sole missing-component sentinel) and :217 (library EMITS hue "none" when OKLCH c<=0.000004).
defects.mechanism: partial-function-over-total-type at a package boundary; Result-to-throw adapter discarding the library's failure-explicit design
defects.reproduction: Navigate to http://localhost:9000/#/about?space=oklch&color=oklch(0.6%200%20none) (or ?color=oklch(none%200.1%20200), or ?color=oklch(0.6%20none%20200)). #app renders zero children; console shows a single pageerror. Script: scratchpad/probe-cnl4.mjs.
defects.proposedCure: Delete valueOrThrow. Lower AnyColor to a narrower `ResolvedColor` (channels: number) exactly ONCE at the parse/URL-restore boundary, returning a Result the boot path renders as the existing configuration-error surface. Every downstream function (channelNumber, withChannel, ink.ts) then becomes total by construction. Optionally /color publishes `resolvePowerless(color)` so every consumer stops inventing the same lowering.

defects.defect: "The channels of a color space" — name, min, max, unit — is declared five times across two packages with no owner, and the copies contradict each other on the same rendered page.

result.strongestDefect: P2-1 — ConfigSliderPane is a demo fork of glass-ui 7.0.0's SHIPPED `<Configurator>` chassis. glass-ui exports `Configurator<T>` (generic over the live config, with presets/layers/scrollMode-FadingScroll/size/asideSide/asideWidth and a `footer` slot exposing `reset`), `<ConfiguratorLayer>` (whose own .d.ts names AURORA as the intended consumer: "per R2 §C: aurora has Medium / Palette / Flow / Texture / Comp / Nuclei"), and `useConfiguratorState<T>` (config/isDirty/selectPreset/resetCurrent/cyclePreset, with a `cloneMode: "per-preset"` rung the producer literally labels "aurora shape"). The demo re-rolled every one of them except ConfiguratorRow — hand-rolled readPath/writePath, `Object.assign(config, structuredClone(defaults))` for reset, a hand-built scroll-fade region, a hand-built footer dock, a hand-built section header. ConfigSliderPane.vue:6-10 ADMITS knowing about the module ("glass-ui already ships ./configurator with ConfiguratorRow + useConfiguratorState") and dismisses the rest as "thin structural shells, not the row primitive" — but Configurator, ConfiguratorLayer and useConfiguratorState ARE those shells and they ship; `grep useConfiguratorState|ConfiguratorLayer|<Configurator demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue` returns nothing. This fork is the ROOT of the stringly-typed `config: Record<string, unknown>` surface (pass-1 L-6): the generic `T` seam pass 1 proposed inventing already exists in the dependency.
result.negativeProof: Not SOUND — verdict is DEFECTIVE. But the following were checked and cleared, and are recorded as negative proofs in the report: (1) NO deep `src/` import anywhere in the 16-module transitive closure — the only value.js specifiers reached are `@mkbabb/value.js/color` and `@mkbabb/value.js/css`, both published `package.json#exports` keys; every value.js import in this graph is one a real external consumer could write, so the T.W1 demo-dogfood keystone HOLDS. (2) No phantom dependency: `reka-ui` is a declared devDependency (package.json:106, "reka-ui": "^2.9"). (3) verbatimModuleSyntax fully compliant — AuroraPane.vue 4/4 type-only imports use `import type` (:25, :26-31, :34); aurora-atoms.ts 2/2; aurora-harmony-stops.ts 2/2; no mixed import. (4) `fmt()` at aurora-harmony-stops.ts:26-28 is CORRECT — I traced /\.?0+$/ against "240.0000"/"100.5000"/"0.0000"; `0+` cannot span the decimal point so the match always anchors at or after the dot (240→"240", 100.5→"100.5"). Raised as a suspect, killed as a finding. (5) `--tracking-caps` IS a real token, bridged by glass-ui's `@theme inline` in dist/styles/theme/bridges.css — the "undefined custom property → invalid-at-computed-value-time" hypothesis was raised and DISPROVED. (6) `npx vitest run demo/test/glass/aurora-bracket.test.ts demo/test/glass/aurora-motion.test.ts` → "Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 8 passed (8)" in 1.35s. (7) REPORT.json /#/atmosphere across all four Safari matrices: pageErrors 0, consoleErrors 0, overflowX 0, main count 1, no dark-class miss. (8) Reduced motion NOT born-RED (root-verified raf/1.5s=0 under reducedMotion:reduce; loop is glass-ui-owned). (9) C2 aurora palette-blind static-Sky NOT re-litigated — known chronic with a glass-ui-side root.

defects.defect: CORRECTION to pass-1 L-12: the three 12x24 slider-thumb tap-target defects on /#/atmosphere are attributed to glass-ui. The measurement is right; the attribution is wrong. result.negativeProof: Not applicable to the verdict (DEFECTIVE), but recorded so the verdict is not read as blanket. Attacked and could not break: (1) the UNGUARDED `PICKER_CHANNELS[…]` lookup at :219 — `convertColor` rejects every unknown space id (`bogus`/`srgb`/`HEX`/`""` → color_invalid_input) and `parseCssColor` normalizes every notation to a SpaceId the frozen table covers (`color(srgb …)`→rgb, `color(xyz-d50 …)`→xyz), and both injection seams (useColorUrl.ts:30-47, boot/hydrate.ts:80-91) convert-then-fall-through, so no crash path exists today. (2) All 44 advertised conversion paths in colorSpaceInfo.conversions walk successfully through the real library, node by node (scratchpad/graph-edges.mjs: 44/44 ok). (3) No leak surface: zero requestAnimationFrame / addEventListener / observer / timer / async / fetch in the file (grep count 0), no ValueUnit construction, no parseCssColor call, no reka-ui slider; instance census during a drag shows liveInstancesSeen: 1 — no duplicated or leaked instances. (4) KeepAlive pauses it: after in-app navigation to /#/gradient a 40-step drag produced ZERO ColorNutritionLabel updates and 0 graph nodes in the DOM (cnl-c2-probe1.mjs §B) — Vue 3.5's deactivated-subtree effect pausing holds. (6) Zero pageerrors across all eight browser probes; REPORT records horizontalOverflow 0 and pageErrors 0 for /#/ in all four Safari matrices. Producer-side coordination packet (glass-ui is not ours to edit this formation): SelectContent needs a resting opacity or an opaque scrim beneath the blur sufficient for content-over-chroma compositions.

defects.defect: The selected option paints ZERO pixels. `aria-selected="true"` is announced while the producer's marker element computes `background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0)` — selected-state delta is 0px in light, dark, monochrome and forced colors. (Corrects pass-1, which read the `data-highlighted` focus ring as the selection marker.)
defects.evidence: pass2/probes/D-probe5.mjs measured on `[role=option][aria-selected=true][data-state=checked]`: marker element present 8×8px at (334,331.3), inline style `background-color: var(--select-dot-color, var(--glass-accent, currentColor))`, computed `rgba(0,0,0,0)`; `--select-dot-color` = "" (unset); `--glass-accent` = "rgba(0,0,0,0)" (defined, transparent). pass2/probes/D-aurora-probe3.mjs with keyboard moved two rows off: Analogous sel=true → bg rgba(0,0,0,0), outline none, box-shadow none; Split Complementary hl="" → bg oklab(0.9156…/0.52) + 2px ring. defects.mechanism: CSS `var()` falls through only on an UNDEFINED custom property, never on a defined-but-transparent one. `--glass-accent` is defined as `rgba(0,0,0,0)` at `:root`, so it wins the fallback chain and `currentColor` is unreachable. The defect hides from casual capture because reka seeds `data-highlighted` onto the selected row at open time, so the first screenshot after opening shows a ring that actually belongs to focus.
defects.reproduction: node pass2/probes/D-probe5.mjs → dot.backgroundColor === "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)". Or: open the Harmony menu, press ArrowDown twice, observe that nothing marks 'Analogous' as current (pass2/frames/D-menu-kb.png).
defects.proposedCure: Consumer half: set `--select-dot-color` at the pane root to a certified ink with a nonzero delta in all four schemes. Producer half (coordination packet, not a wave): ink the SelectItem marker through a token that cannot be transparent, or floor the chain with `color-mix`/`@supports` instead of relying on undefined-only `var()` fallthrough — every glass-ui Select consumer under a transparent-accent root inherits an invisible selected state.

The 6 declined include `lightnessScheme`, whose absence leaves the derived ramp in the light-pastel band regardless of shell scheme — precisely the failure the producer documented the atom to prevent. defects.defect: glass-ui ships `LabeledField`/`LabeledSelect` — the labeled accessible-form-control primitive with a label column, real for/aria-labelledby, and disabled/invalid/requirement/error seats — and the demo consumes it ZERO times. Because the chosen primitive cannot express label association, disabled, invalid, requirement or error, those states are not merely unimplemented — the seat for them does not exist. Owner edicts 3 (KISS, no contrivance) and 4 (glass-ui is the design system).
defects.reproduction: node pass2/probes/D-aurora-probe.mjs → every row reports ariaLabelledby: null, labelHasId: false. Clicking the visible 'HARMONY' text does nothing (pass-1 D-7 labelClick before/after: expanded stays "false", focus stays BODY).

One spine, one measure, one container-scaled rhythm, one label voice, one accessible name per control — and the ragged column, the inert label, the two-vocabulary naming and the missing disabled/invalid states all close together.

defects.defect: The control column is ragged by construction: each Select trigger's inline size and start edge are a function of its label's rendered string length. Four sibling controls of one species get three different measures.
defects.evidence: AuroraPane.vue:187-192 `.aurora-row { display:flex; justify-content: space-between; }`. Measured 1440 (pass2/probes/D-aurora-probe.json): trigger x = 318.10 / 365.06 / 306.41 / 306.41, widths 897.86 / 850.94 / 909.59 / 909.59 → spread 58.65px, EXACTLY the label-width delta (ARRANGEMENT 129.06 − MEDIUM 70.41 = 58.65). Mobile 390: spread 50.08px = 14.0% of the 358px card. NEW 320px arm: `min-w-menu` (--menu-min-w: 11rem = 176px, foundation.css:445) clamps two rows → widths 176/176/181.9/181.9, a 5.9px mismatch. RTL mirrors the raggedness to the trailing edge (all triggers x 224, right edges 1121.9/1074.9/1133.6/1133.6).
defects.mechanism: `space-between` anchors the label at the inline-start and the control at the inline-end, so the control's start is whatever the label's text width leaves. A label column and a control column are a grid (or a `LabeledField layout="horizontal"`), not a space-between flex row. There is no label column.
defects.reproduction: node pass2/probes/D-aurora-probe.mjs; or open pass2/frames/D-probe-forced-colors.png, where the glass is stripped and the four outlined pills visibly start at four different x.
defects.proposedCure: Same cure as N-4 — `LabeledSelect layout="horizontal"` supplies the shared label column and one control measure. Do NOT fix by hand-tuning a min-width or a fixed label width.

defects.defect: Hierarchy inversion by literal copy: `.aurora-row-label` is a byte-identical duplicate of `.config-section-title`, so four LEAF field labels are typographically indistinguishable from the GROUP heading beneath them, while differing from their own peer labels in family, weight, tracking, case and colour.
defects.evidence: AuroraPane.vue:194-200 vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:237-243 — five identical declarations (font-family var(--font-mono); font-size var(--type-small); text-transform uppercase; letter-spacing var(--tracking-caps); color var(--muted-foreground)). Measured computed, both: `"Fira Code" 16.4px, uppercase, letter-spacing 1.64px, rgb(112,89,66)` — zero delta. Peer slider label 'Colour Energy' computes Plus Jakarta Sans 500 rgb(28,25,23). Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4 puts labels at Plus Jakarta `text-small` and reserves Fira Code for value/code/provenance; glass-ui already ships this exact recipe as a named role, `.section-label { @apply text-mono-caption; color: var(--muted-foreground) }` (dist/styles/typography/utilities.css).
defects.mechanism: A section-heading role was copy-pasted onto a field-label role in a second file. The muted colour compounds it: the four enum rows read as secondary or disabled relative to the three slider rows, when all seven are peer atoms of the same AuroraAtoms door. CORRECTION to pass 1: this is a §4 jurisdiction breach and a hierarchy inversion, NOT a `1/√φ` breach — PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:15-16 is a Picker/P019 clause that VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4 names 'the sole paired-scale exception', and it does not reach a form label and its control value.
defects.reproduction: Diff AuroraPane.vue:194-200 against ConfigSliderPane.vue:237-243 (identical). Or read shots/safari-desktop-light/atmosphere.png: 'HARMONY' and 'FIELD' are the same type; 'HARMONY' and 'Colour Energy' look like different kinds of thing.
defects.proposedCure: Delete both local classes. `LabeledSelect`'s label arm carries the producer's single label role for all seven rows; if a caps voice is genuinely wanted for group titles, it stays on `.config-section-title` alone and never on a leaf.

defects.defect: `text-caption` is stamped on all four triggers and all eighteen options; its font-size arm loses to the producer's `text-dropdown`, but its `font-style: italic` arm has no competitor and lands. Every control value and dropdown option therefore renders in the design system's ANNOTATION voice. (Corrects pass 1, which recorded the class as fully dead.)
defects.evidence: AuroraPane.vue:122,129,142,146,156,160,170,174. glass-ui semantic.css: `@utility text-caption { font-family: var(--font-text); font-size: var(--type-caption); line-height: var(--type-leading-caption); font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; }`; glass-ui's competing rule is exactly one declaration, `text-dropdown{font-size:var(--dropdown-text)}`. Measured at the trigger's own container (pass2/probes/D-probe7.mjs): computed font-size 16.4px, computed font-style ITALIC; --type-caption resolves 14.384px, --type-small 16.4px, --dropdown-text 16.4px. Live class list contains BOTH `text-dropdown` and `text-caption`. Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4 — 'control or label, INCLUDING DROPDOWN OPTIONS → text-small … Plus Jakarta Sans, non-bold'; the matrix is declared closed.
defects.mechanism: Two utilities on one element: the later one in the compiled sheet wins font-size (text-dropdown, 16.4px), while font-style has a single declarant (text-caption) and always applies. The consequence is that the row's protagonist — the current value — wears the voice of the pane description (PaneHeader.vue:29 `.pane-header-desc`, visibly italic in every screenshot), which reads as placeholder text. Owner edict 5 (root-level styling, never per-instance overrides): 8 per-instance overrides.
defects.reproduction: node pass2/probes/D-probe7.mjs → computedFontStyle 'italic', computedFontSize '16.4px', --type-caption 14.384px. Visible in every one of the four Safari captures.
defects.proposedCure: Delete all eight `text-caption` stamps and add NOTHING in their place. glass-ui's `text-dropdown` already resolves to --type-small = 16.4px, i.e. exactly the rung §4 mandates for controls and dropdown options — the producer default is canon-conformant underneath. This is the cheapest cure in the report and it also closes N-6.

defects.defect: The italic caption face clips its own terminal glyph: the value box is sized to the glyph advance width and carries `overflow: hidden; text-overflow: clip`, so italic ink painting past the advance is sliced. Layout reports no overflow, so no scrollWidth check can detect it.
defects.evidence: Measured (pass2/probes/D-aurora-probe2.mjs): value span `overflow: hidden`, `text-overflow: clip`, `font-style: italic`; clientWidth === scrollWidth (74 === 74 for 'Scattered') while getBoundingClientRect().width = 73.67. Rendered proof at DPR 3: pass2/frames/D-rows-3x.png — 'Scattered' loses the right stem of its final `d` to a straight vertical cut. Reproduced at DPR 2 in pass2/frames/D-probe-zoom200.png ('Scattereᴅ', 'Smootһ', 'Driftin').
defects.mechanism: `overflow: hidden` clips PAINT, not just layout. A box sized to the advance width of an italic run cannot contain the run's ink, and `text-overflow: clip` slices rather than ellipsises. An upright control face has no right-side ink overhang, which is why the producer's own `text-dropdown` never exhibits this.
defects.reproduction: node pass2/probes/D-aurora-probe2.mjs → parts[1] = { text:'Scattered', cw:74, sw:74, overflow:'hidden', textOverflow:'clip', fontStyle:'italic', rect.w:73.67 }. Then open pass2/frames/D-rows-3x.png.
defects.proposedCure: Closed by C-1's cure — deleting `text-caption` removes the italic, and the producer's upright control face fits its own box. No overflow/padding hack should be added.

defects.defect: The pane advertises a 7-way medium axis and collapses 5 of the 7 to a single unparameterised state: every textured medium carries an `amount` axis in the producer's atom type that nothing in the demo ever writes.
defects.evidence: AuroraPane.vue:85-91 — `atoms.medium = kind === "smooth" ? { kind } : { kind };` (arms byte-identical at runtime; the ternary exists only to narrow the discriminant for TS, while the 3-line comment above it asserts a behavioural difference that does not exist). glass-ui atoms.d.ts:160-176 — `{ medium: { kind: Exclude<AuroraMedium,"smooth">; amount?: number } }`. MEDIA at AuroraPane.vue:54-62 offers smooth, pastel, watercolor, oil, crayon, vangogh, oil-pastel. `grep` for any write of `medium.amount` in demo/ → none. Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §7 'every select/axis has an observable effect on its live preview'.
defects.mechanism: The consumer's atom door is narrower than the producer's. Watercolor, Oil, Crayon, Vangogh and Oil-Pastel each have exactly one strength, permanently — a seven-way choice over a space that is really 2 kinds × 1 unreachable amplitude. Same family one line up: `setArrangement` (:82-84) rebuilds `{count, arrangement}` from scratch, so any sibling key on `zones` is dropped on every arrangement change — structurally lossy independent of today's atom shape.
defects.reproduction: Read AuroraPane.vue:85-91 (both ternary arms are `{ kind }`) against atoms.d.ts:160-176 (`amount?: number` on the textured arm). Select 'Watercolor' in the app: no amplitude control appears anywhere.
defects.proposedCure: Collapse the dead ternary to a single write; expose `medium.amount` as a slider that mounts only for textured kinds (the discriminated union already types it); make `setArrangement` a targeted field write rather than an object rebuild.

defects.defect: Advanced knobs first, essentials below the fold: the four advanced enum atoms consume 42.3% of the control acreage and sit ABOVE the three continuous atoms, so at the 200%-zoom arm 54.3% of the form is behind an inner scroller whose only cue is a fade mask.
defects.evidence: Independently re-measured at 720×450 / DPR 2 (pass2/probes/D-aurora-probe.json, zoom200.scrollers): `.pane-scroll-fade` scrollHeight 567 / clientHeight 259 = 45.7% visible; `.app-layout` 456/450. Pass-1: mobile 632/456 → 176px hidden = 27.8%; enumBlockH 192.00 vs wellH 261.77. Canon: OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:46 and VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §3.1 specify order 'preview; essentials; advanced'; §3 law 6 wants one document-scrolling mobile sequence.
defects.mechanism: AuroraPane fills ConfigSliderPane's default slot, which renders ABOVE the slider sections by construction — so the pane's ordering is an artefact of which slot a control landed in, not of rank. ConfigSliderPane.vue:98-106 then makes the card a fixed-height inner scroller (`h-full … overflow-y-auto`) rather than letting the document scroll. In shots/safari-mobile-light/atmosphere.png the clip falls between 'Noise 0.500' and its slider — a label severed from the control it names.
defects.reproduction: node pass2/probes/D-aurora-probe.mjs → zoom200.scrollers[1] = {cls:'pane-scroll-fade …', sh:567, ch:259}. Or open pass2/frames/D-probe-zoom200.png: MOTION is sliced in half and the entire FIELD group is below the fold.
defects.proposedCure: Move 1 retires the inner scroller by giving the route a real chassis; within it, order preview → essentials (colour energy, noise, zones) → advanced disclosure (harmony, arrangement, medium, motion), with the advanced group scroll-confined per §3.1 rather than the whole pane.

defects.defect: The component types itself on a devDependency, reaching past the design system for a type the design system already narrows — and then must launder every value with a runtime coercion plus an unchecked assertion.
defects.evidence: AuroraPane.vue:25 `import type { AcceptableValue } from "reka-ui";`. package.json `dependencies` = exactly { "@mkbabb/glass-ui": "^7.0.0", "@mkbabb/keyframes.js": "^6.0.0" }; reka-ui is a devDependency. glass-ui dist/components/select/Select.vue.d.ts:13-14 — `export interface SelectEmits { "update:modelValue": [value: SelectionValue] }` with `SelectionValue = string | number` (dist/components/_shared/selection.d.ts). Launders at AuroraPane.vue:79, :83, :89, :93 — `String(v) as AuroraHarmony` etc.
defects.mechanism: Because the imported type is wider than the emit actually is, each setter needs `String(...)` (a runtime coercion) plus an `as` assertion (unchecked), and nothing validates the result against HARMONIES / ARRANGEMENTS / MEDIA / MOTIONS. Owner edicts 2 (no masking fallbacks) and 4 (glass-ui is the boundary). `import type` erases at build, so this is a layering and correctness defect, not a runtime one.
defects.reproduction: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies)" → only glass-ui and keyframes.js. Then read AuroraPane.vue:25 and :79.
defects.proposedCure: Type the four handlers on glass-ui's own `SelectionValue` (or let `LabeledSelect`'s `modelValue: string` type them, per N-4), delete the reka-ui import and all four `String(...) as …` launders. If a runtime guard is genuinely wanted, validate against the local const arrays rather than asserting.

defects.defect: The pane has no designed empty/error state and asserts its own provider: `inject(AURORA_ATOMS_KEY)!` with no guard, no fallback, no error boundary. With the provider absent the first property read throws during render and takes the route down.
defects.evidence: AuroraPane.vue:42 `const atoms = inject(AURORA_ATOMS_KEY)!;` — non-null assertion. `harmony()` at :73 reads `atoms.harmony` unconditionally. Family context: usePaneRouter.ts:77 mounts it as a bare `defineAsyncComponent(() => import(...))` with no `loadingComponent` and no `errorComponent`, so a chunk-load failure also renders nothing, silently.
defects.mechanism: The component's design admits exactly one state (provider present, atoms populated). Per the seat law, a state that was never designed is a design defect — here empty, loading and error are all undesigned, and the primitive chosen for the rows (N-4) has no seat for disabled or invalid either.
defects.reproduction: NONE — labelled a HYPOTHESIS. I did not execute a provider-less mount. The static claim is exact (inject returns undefined; `atoms.harmony` throws TypeError during render), but no reproduction was run.
defects.proposedCure: Either provide a typed default via `inject(KEY, DEFAULT_AURORA_ATOMS)` so the pane is renderable standalone, or fail loudly and locally with a designed error state rather than a thrown render. Separately, give the async route mount a `loadingComponent`/`errorComponent` — family-wide, not AuroraPane-local.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation (AuroraPane, demo/scenes/atmosphere/AuroraPane.vue), pass 2
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]`, the tier this seat was explicitly spawned with, declared not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: C-2 — the harmony PreviewStrip, the pane's only truth-bearing affordance, disagrees with the field it claims to preview in 210/510 measured seed×harmony cases and at both live seeds driven (Δ up to 44 rgb units/channel), violating the O-14 byte-identity law the file states in its own header; and the oracle that names that law compares the strip to itself at the exact seed where divergence is largest, so the gate is INVERTED (deleting the seam guarantee makes the test pass harder while making the product worse). C-3 then shows the resolver the strip must be re-pointed at is itself broken in 7.5% of firings, so the cure is a real repair, not a one-line re-point.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. But 13 hazard classes were checked and proven SOUND with positive evidence, including one hypothesis of mine that was REFUTED and recorded as such: I suspected `aria-label` on the four SelectTriggers suppressed the current value from the a11y tree; the raw CDP node (probes/pass2/p5-ax-raw.mjs) shows role="combobox", name="Palette harmony" (nameFrom aria-label), value={"type":"string","value":"Analogous"}, hasPopup=listbox — name AND value both exposed. Also SOUND: zero rAF/listeners/timers/async in the file (the PRM-RAF and cleanup classes are structurally absent, not merely unobserved); PreviewStrip is aria-hidden="true" so option names and typeahead are clean; 6-of-6 distinct data-stops (the chronic C2 palette-blindness does not manifest); focus restores to the trigger on Escape on both matrices; Reset restores exactly ["Analogous","Scattered","Smooth","Drifting"] without clobbering the picker seed; WCAG 2.5.3 Label-in-Name passes on all four rows; zero page/console errors and zero horizontal overflow across all four real-Safari matrices and all seven of my live runs; verbatimModuleSyntax honoured on all four type-only import groups; demo/ui/select is a pure glass-ui re-export; HARMONIES/ARRANGEMENTS/MOTIONS are complete against the consumed unions (6/6, 3/3, 3/3).

defects.defect: On the shipped "css" render substrate, five of AuroraPane's seven knobs (medium, zones.count, zones.arrangement, noise, motion) are structurally inert, with no disabled state, notice or degraded label. useAtmosphere.ts:158 resolves the substrate once at setup; on the css tier the atmosphere is paletteToCssGradient(resolvedPalette) — palette only — and those five atoms drive nuclei/warp/texture/drift, which only the shader reads. AuroraPane never injects or consults auroraRenderMode.
defects.evidence: demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:158 and :207-211; demo/scenes/atmosphere/AuroraPane.vue:97-106,117-180. Measured (probes/pass2/p8-control.mjs, motion=Still so the baseline hashes identically twice): POSITIVE CONTROLS move pixels — harmony=Monochrome/Triad/Complementary patchMoved=true, Colour Energy 0.76→0.060 patchMoved=true. NEGATIVES byte-identical PNG — Painterly medium=Watercolor patchMoved=false, =Vangogh false, Zone arrangement=Centred false, Motion=Drifting false, Noise 0.5→1.0 false. Substrate confirmed by probes/pass2/p7-liveness.mjs: renderer="ANGLE (Google, Vulkan 1.3.0 (SwiftShader Device (LLVM 10.0.0)))", fullPageGradientEl="BODY.relative", body background-image="linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(200,70,215) 0%, ...)".
defects.mechanism: A device-tier capability is computed at one site and consumed at none; the pane's knob set is a static literal with no relation to what the live substrate can express. Same honesty law the repo already wrote for the canvas (useAtmosphere.ts:283-290, 'never a blank canvas presented as a field') left unapplied to the controls.
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/AuroraPane/probes/pass2/p8-control.mjs against http://localhost:9000 in headless Chromium (SwiftShader ⇒ the css tier). Scoped honestly: on a real-GPU device the WebGL field is armed and these knobs live.
defects.proposedCure: useAtmosphere already computes auroraRenderMode — provide it beside AURORA_ATOMS_KEY (one more provide, zero new modules). Tag each SliderSection def and enum row substrate:"palette"|"field"; render the field-only rows disabled with the one-line reason the composable already writes in prose. Seven honest knobs beats seven of which five lie.

defects.defect: The harmony PreviewStrip lies about the field it previews — the O-14 byte-identity truth law is violated at this site. aurora-harmony-stops.ts:38 returns resolveCalibratedAtmosphere(...).palette; what selecting actually paints is guaranteeSeamOffset(resolveCalibratedAtmosphere(...), seed) (useAtmosphere.ts:170 and :181), a uniform L shift of up to DERIVE_SEAM_FLOOR=0.06 that the strip never applies.
defects.evidence: Law stated at demo/scenes/atmosphere/aurora-harmony-stops.ts:6-8; strip at :38; referent at demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:170,181. LIVE (probes/pass2/p4-truth-and-ax.mjs, reads the selected row's stamped data-stops, converts via glass-ui oklchStopToHex, compares to --saved-bg-0..3): seed oklch(0.5 0.16 10) STRIP rgb [[90,23,98],[148,35,92],[192,71,67],[211,125,54]] vs GROUND [[105,39,112],[165,52,106],[210,87,81],[228,140,71]], IDENTICAL? false, delta [[-15,-16,-14],...]. Seed oklch(0.62 0.27 9.8) — the exact seed the O-14 unit oracle uses — STRIP [[141,0,155],[211,0,127],[255,77,77],[255,155,77]] vs GROUND [[160,37,174],[233,44,145],[255,99,95],[255,175,97]], delta up to -44 on green. GRID (probes/pass2/p2-seam.mjs): 'strip != field in 210 / 510 (seed x harmony) cases; max |dL| = 0.0600'.
defects.mechanism: A truth function and its referent were separated when P9-R3 landed in the provider; the strip module was never re-pointed. Its oracle is structurally incapable of noticing (see C-9).
defects.reproduction: node probes/pass2/p4-truth-and-ax.mjs; or open http://localhost:9000/#/atmosphere?space=oklch&color=oklch(0.5%200.16%2010), open the Harmony select, and compare the SELECTED row's strip to the field behind it. At the cold-boot seed the guard does not fire and the strip is exact — which is why every gate has passed it.
defects.proposedCure: The seam guarantee is part of the field resolver, not a decoration on it: export one resolveAtmosphereField(atoms) from boot/atmosphere-calibration.ts composing resolveCalibratedAtmosphere ∘ guaranteeSeamOffset, and make useAtmosphere and aurora-harmony-stops both consume it — one resolver, two consumers, the shape the O-14 palettes-ramp leg already uses. BLOCKED ON C-3: the resolver must be repaired first.

defects.defect: guaranteeSeamOffset does not deliver its own stated guarantee, and its 'internal spread preserved' claim is false. The headroom test is computed on the palette MEAN while the clamp is applied per STOP, so extreme stops pin before the mean has travelled; and in the direction-flip branch the required travel is FLOOR+|delta| while the headroom checked was need=FLOOR-|delta|.
defects.evidence: demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:88-90 (the contract) and :99-108 (the implementation: `const headroom = dir === 1 ? 0.98 - meanL : meanL - 0.02; if (headroom < need) dir = -dir; ... clamp(stop.L + push, 0.02, 0.98)`). Measured (probes/pass2/p2-seam.mjs): 'guard FIRED in 1200 cases; guarantee BROKEN in 90 of them', e.g. {"seed":"oklch(0.77 0 25)","h":"analogous","want":0.06,"got":0.0575}; and 'guard fired 120 times; internal L-spread CHANGED in 9', e.g. {"seed":"oklch(0.78 0 25)","spreadBefore":0.32,"spreadAfter":0.30}.
defects.mechanism: A closed-form guarantee sized against an aggregate (the mean) but enforced against elements (per-stop clamp). The two quantities diverge exactly at the domain boundary the clamp exists to protect.
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/AuroraPane/probes/pass2/p2-seam.mjs (sections B and C). The demo functions are transcribed verbatim from atmosphere-calibration.ts:95-103 and useAtmosphere.ts:92-110, cited in the probe header.
defects.proposedCure: Clamp-aware and still closed-form: compute the push, apply it, measure the realised mean, and if the clamp ate any of it solve once more against the true per-stop headroom min(0.98 - max(L), min(L) - 0.02). Two passes, no iteration. Or drop the per-stop clamp and let the derive domain own the range. NOTE: code lives in useAtmosphere.ts, not the pane — reported here because it is the referent of the pane's strip and C-2's cure inherits it.

defects.defect: Three of the ten media glass-ui 7 ships are unreachable through the pane — kuwahara, metal, metal-gradient — and the `AuroraMedium[]` annotation cannot catch the omission because a subset type-checks perfectly.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/atmosphere/AuroraPane.vue:54-62 lists 7; node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/aurora/constants/presets.d.ts:52 declares 10. probes/pass2/p1-vocabulary.mjs: 'MEDIA pane=7 dist=10 MISSING=["kuwahara","metal","metal-gradient"] EXTRA=[]' and 'kuwahara resolved medium=kuwahara reachable=true inPaneUI=false <-- SHIPPED BUT UNREACHABLE IN THE UI' (same for metal, metal-gradient). HARMONIES 6/6, ARRANGEMENTS 3/3, MOTIONS 3/3 are complete — only MEDIA drifted.
defects.mechanism: A hand-maintained duplicate of a producer union with no drift detector, annotated with a type that accepts any subset. The three complete vocabularies mean nobody noticed the one that drifted.
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/AuroraPane/probes/pass2/p1-vocabulary.mjs (sections A and B).
defects.proposedCure: Make completeness checkable rather than hoped-for: a `Record<AuroraMedium, string>` display-name map (exhaustiveness becomes a compile error) whose Object.keys feeds the v-for. One construct, no new module; it also deletes label() and fixes C-11. The next producer medium then fails the build instead of vanishing.

defects.evidence: demo/scenes/atmosphere/AuroraPane.vue:103 `{ key: "zones.count", label: "Zones", min: 1, max: 6, step: 1 }`; the justification frozen in prose at demo/scenes/atmosphere/aurora-atoms.ts:35-38 ('MAX_NUCLEI = 6 ... atom-UNREACHABLE at the consumed dist'). defects.defect: A ternary whose two branches are byte-identical at runtime, with a comment explaining a distinction the expression does not make.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-system boundary, proportion/seat law) for `demo/scenes/about/ColorNutritionLabel.vue`

Selecting "Display P3" renders `Created: 1931`, `White Point: Varies (typically D65)`, `Gamut: Limited (device-specific)` and a conversion graph reading RGB→XYZ / RGB→Kelvin / RGB→HSL / RGB→Hex — every factual row wrong, no mark of any kind. Proven live (frame `D-shots/p3-fallback.png`). A reference document that prefers being wrong to being blank has made the one trade never available to it.

Four convictions I attempted and could NOT sustain, recorded so the record is not one-sided: (1) Alert text contrast PASSES — rendered-pixel 5.08:1 light / 5.97:1 dark for the description, 13.52:1 / 9.28:1 for the title; an earlier working figure of 3.19:1 was an oklab-parsed-as-sRGB artifact and is withdrawn. (2) The hovered-node ink IS genuinely certified — `contrastInkFor` yields oklch(0 0 0) on lab(92 88.8 20) = 10.02:1 measured; the F-3 fill/ink split at :204-208 does what its comment claims. (3) NO arity mismatch and NO missing field — all 13 `colorSpaceInfo` entries match their `PICKER_CHANNELS` channel counts and all carry `applications`/`industries`; the `as any` at :160 hides no crash and I found no runtime throw on any reachable path. Also correct by construction: only color properties are transitioned (no layout-forcing animation), no nested `<main>` is emitted, and horizontal overflow is 0 at 320, 390, 1440 and 3440 (`labelOverflowX: 0` in every arm).

defects.defect: The plate silently publishes CIE RGB's 1931 encyclopedia for 6 of the 18 color spaces the selector offers (srgb-linear, display-p3, a98-rgb, prophoto-rgb, rec2020, hex). No 'undocumented' state exists anywhere in the component.

Coverage computed from source: PICKER_SPACE_NAMES=17 vs colorSpaceInfo=13; MISSING = srgb-linear,display-p3,a98-rgb,prophoto-rgb,rec2020. Plus hex via color-model.ts:32-34. Live probe `p3-fallback` (picked:"option") .about-card innerText under the headline 'Display P3': 'Definition: A color space based on the additive mixture of red, green, and blue light. / White Point: Varies (typically D65) / Gamut: Limited (device-specific) / Created: 1931 / Conversion Graph: RGB→XYZ · RGB→Kelvin · RGB→HSL · RGB→Hex'. Frame scratchpad/D-shots/p3-fallback.png. Display P3 was standardised 2015, D65 fixed, DCI-P3 primaries.

defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/ → About header selector → Display P3 (or sRGB Linear / A98 RGB / ProPhoto RGB / Rec2020 / Hex). Read 'Created'.
defects.proposedCure: Merge colorSpaceInfo and PICKER_CHANNELS into ONE record keyed by SpaceId so the compiler refuses a selector option without an article; until an article exists, render its named absence — one line, no Alert, no fabrication.

defects.defect: Every structural device the component uses is one forced-colors deletes — alpha divider, alpha-bordered well, translucent chip fill, two inline style colors. Under forced colors the hovered-vs-resting state delta is 1.00:1 and the component renders as unstructured text.

White fill on 50%-white host over Canvas white = 1.00:1. Frame D-shots/chromium-forced.png: no chips, no panels, no dividers, no highlight. WebKit emulation shows the opposite failure — author colors survive (D-cnl-probe.json forced-colors.names[].computed = oklch(0.519287 0.207684 9.834023)). Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:83 'states are never color-only'; :90 'nonzero delta in monochrome and forced colors'.
defects.mechanism: state and grouping encoded 100% in color/alpha, with no shape, weight, boundary or text carrier; no forced-color-adjust decision taken either way
defects.reproduction: node D-cnl-chromium.mjs, or Chrome DevTools → Rendering → Emulate CSS forced-colors: active → /#/ → scroll About to Conversion Graph → hover a path.
defects.proposedCure: Grouping rides real headings + interval (already ordered by PR-14). Any surviving chip uses 1px solid currentColor plus a non-color state carrier. Live-color surfaces that must remain take forced-color-adjust:none deliberately with a certified ink, not by accident of inline styling.

defects.defect: The conversion-graph hover is a label-membership test, not a path identity: hovering ONE path lights 6 of 10 nodes across all 4 rows.

D-cnl-probe.json desktop-light.hover after hover() on the first path only: {totalNodes:10, styledCount:6, styledTexts:["Lab","XYZ","Lab","Lab","XYZ","Lab"], restingTexts:["LCh","OKLab","LCh","OKLCh"]}. Identical in dark (styledCount 6) and forced colors (6). Frame D-shots/desktop-light-hover.png shows six pink chips across four rows. CI is blind: o18-contrast-census.spec.ts:703-742 hovers .first() and asserts one ratio, never counts styled nodes.

defects.reproduction: /#/ → scroll About pane to Conversion Graph → hover `Lab → XYZ` → count highlighted chips (6).

defects.defect: The type scale inverts: section headings use a FIXED rung while their body/label copy uses FLUID vw clamps, so past ~2086px the data is larger than the heading above it. The heading token is also the wrong role and the wrong family.

Rendered (D-cnl-pixels.json): at 1440 h2=20.352px / name=18.608px / label=16.4px; at 3440 h2=20.352px / name=22px / label=20px. Crossover solves at vw=20.86px → viewport ≈2086px. Frame D-shots/w3440-about.png shows 'Components' smaller than 'L* (Lightness)'. Role matrix VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:73 / PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:78 mandate section heading = text-heading (1.618rem = 25.888px) in Plus Jakarta Sans; the file uses font-display text-subheading at :18,:43,:71,:93,:149 (Fraunces, −21%), and renders values in Jakarta where the same matrix assigns text-mono-small / Fira Code. Three different H2 treatments coexist in one scroll container: 20.352/600, 30/600 accent, 32.928/700.

defects.proposedCure: One ladder: section headings take text-heading / Plus Jakarta Sans, values take text-mono-small; if any rung in the block is fluid, every adjacent rung is fluid on the same curve.

defects.defect: Unconditional grid-cols-2 (50/50) and grid-cols-3 (equal thirds) inside a container hard-capped at 512px while the type is viewport-fluid — density collapses at BOTH ends and the three-column range table loses horizontal alignment at 320px.

defects.defect: The component's only chromatic data channel dies in dark mode (chroma collapses 8.95×) and in light lands 18–19% below the producing module's own declared certification target.
