result.axis: CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownership, dependency direction, public surface) for demo/scenes/about/AboutPane.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m], 1M context) — declared at spawn, not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: L-1+L-2 as one mechanism: AboutPane renders three hand-maintained enumerations of the SAME concept (the color-space set) at three different cardinalities — 18 selectable (ColorSpaceSelector.vue:150) / 13 fact rows (colorSpaceInfo.ts) / 11 markdown guides (AboutPane.vue:79) — side by side on one page, with a cast (`as MarkdownSpace`, AboutPane.vue:97) and a fallback (`: colorSpaceInfo.rgb`, ColorNutritionLabel.vue:214) installed to suppress exactly the compiler errors that would have caught the divergence. Reproduced live: 7 of 18 states lose the Detailed Guide entirely (heading renders over dead space), and 5 of those additionally render RGB's facts — definition, D65-varies white point, "Limited (device-specific)" gamut, Created 1931, and RGB→XYZ/Kelvin/HSL/Hex conversion chips — under the *other space's* title. The repo already owns the cure one module away: PICKER_CHANNELS at picker-color.ts:70 is total over all 17 spaces because `satisfies Record<SpaceId, …>` enforces it.
result.negativeProof: Four suspects checked and cleared with positive evidence, one of which I nearly filed as a false finding. (1) The three-parallel-useDark-stores suspect named in the brief at useMarkdownHighlighting.ts:76 is CURED — that line is a comment recording the cure; `grep -rn "useDark" demo/ | grep -v useGlobalDark` returns exactly one hit and it is prose inside a comment. All 8 real call sites use `useGlobalDark` from `@mkbabb/glass-ui/dark`. (2) The markdown overflow architecture is SOUND and the visual audit is wrong about it: REPORT.json safari-desktop-light /#/ records `bleeding: [path, math, semantics, mrow, msup, mi, mo, mo, mn, mrow, mo, mi]`, but measured in WebKit the `.katex-mathml` a11y mirror is correctly hidden (`clip-path: inset(50%)`, width 1px) and capture.mjs:83-86's vis() filter only tests width>0 && height>0, so those 12 rows are false positives of the instrument; the AB-1 scroll cure at Markdown.vue:301-306 is live (`overflowX: "auto"`, measured 316px scroll range on the wide L*a*b* formula, 43px on another), and `.katex-display` shows leftOverhang 0 / rightOverhang 0 so no bidirectional-centered-overflow trap exists. I withdrew this after a first measurement taken before content-visibility:auto had materialised the off-screen blocks. (3) The demo genuinely dogfoods the published surface: `grep -rn 'from "@mkbabb/value.js"' demo/` → 0 hits, `grep -rn "@src/" demo/` → 0 hits; all 50 value.js imports go through published subpaths (/color ×25, /css ×10, /math ×6, /easing ×5, /quantize ×4), every one writable by a real consumer — the L-5 defect is in the config that *describes* the surface, not in the code. (4) No god modules in the closure: largest are Markdown.vue 408 lines (~330 scoped CSS with rationale), useContrastSafeColor.ts 376 lines / 4 exports, AboutPane.vue 100 lines; verbatimModuleSyntax fully compliant (AboutPane.vue:72,74 both `import type`).

defects.defect: Masking fallback renders RGB's facts under five other color spaces' names. ColorNutritionLabel.vue:210-215 falls back to `colorSpaceInfo.rgb` for any space missing from the 13-key table, converting "no data" into "wrong data" — the canonical owner-edict-2 violation.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/about/ColorNutritionLabel.vue:210-215 (`return space in colorSpaceInfo ? colorSpaceInfo[space as keyof typeof colorSpaceInfo] : colorSpaceInfo.rgb;`). colorSpaceInfo.ts has 13 keys (:18 rgb, :41 hsl, :68 hsv, :93 hwb, :115 lab, :142 lch, :162 oklab, :188 oklch, :209 xyz, :240 kelvin, :261 ictcp, :287 jzazbz, :313 hex) and closes `} as const;` at :334 with no constraint; the selector offers 18 (ColorSpaceSelector.vue:150 `Object.entries(DISPLAY_COLOR_SPACE_NAMES)` over picker-color.ts:72-90's 17 SpaceIds + hex). Live probe output after selecting Display P3: `"Definition": "A color space based on the additive mixture of red, green, and blue light." / "Device Dependency:" "Device-dependent" / "White Point:" "Varies (typically D65)" / "Gamut:" "Limited (device-specific)"` — all four false for Display P3 (wide-gamut, D65, device-independent), with `Created: 1931` and RGB→XYZ/Kelvin/HSL/Hex conversion chips. Screenshots viewed: scratchpad/about-Display-P3.png, scratchpad/about-p3-bottom.png.
defects.mechanism: Partial lookup table with an unconstrained key type plus a fallback branch that substitutes a wrong row instead of failing — masking fallback / no compiler-enforced totality.
defects.reproduction: Dev server live at http://localhost:9000. `node scratchpad/probe2.mjs` (isolated @playwright/test Chromium 1600x1100; the MCP browser was locked by a sibling seat). Manually: load http://localhost:9000/, click the inline color-space selector in the About pane title, select "Display P3", read the Definition/Basic Information rows. Affects srgb-linear, display-p3, a98-rgb, prophoto-rgb, rec2020 — 5 of 18 states.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the fallback branch entirely and make the table total: change `} as const;` at colorSpaceInfo.ts:334 to `} satisfies Record<DisplayColorSpace, SpaceFacts>;` — the exact mechanism picker-color.ts:70 already uses for PICKER_CHANNELS (`Object.freeze({…} satisfies Record<SpaceId, readonly ChannelMeta[]>)`), which is why that table is complete over all 17. The compiler then names the 5 missing rows at build time and `currentColorSpaceInfo` collapses to a plain total lookup with no branch.

defects.defect: A private duplicate union plus a type cast erase the domain type, so 7 of 18 states render a "Detailed Guide" heading over nothing — and the purpose-built error state that should cover this case is unreachable dead code.
defects.evidence: AboutPane.vue:79 declares an 11-member private union `type MarkdownSpace = "rgb"|"hex"|"hsl"|"hsv"|"hwb"|"lab"|"lch"|"oklab"|"oklch"|"xyz"|"kelvin"` duplicating `DisplayColorSpace` (color-model.ts:29, 18 members); AboutPane.vue:97 casts `model.value.selectedColorSpace as MarkdownSpace`. Standalone tsc probe (scratchpad/tscast/probe.ts, --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler) proves the cast is exactly load-bearing: `probe.ts(17,28): error TS7053: ... Property 'display-p3' does not exist on type 'Record<MarkdownSpace, DocModule>'.` and the satisfies cure `probe.ts(22,3): error TS1360: ... missing the following properties: "display-p3", rec2020, hsl, hsv, and 12 more.` Live: `hasDetailedGuide: true, hasMarkdownBody: false, hasOhSnap: false` for both Display P3 and Jzazbz; card foot text ends `"...Entertainment, Gaming\nDetailed Guide"`. Markdown.vue:19-30 ships a styled "Oh snap... We couldn't find the documentation for the selected color space." Alert that can never fire because AboutPane.vue:51 `v-if="activeMarkdownModule"` gates the component out before mount, and AboutPane is Markdown's sole consumer (grep for `{ Markdown }` across demo/ → only AboutPane.vue:70,71).
defects.mechanism: Second private enumeration of an existing domain type + an `as` cast that launders the wider type into the narrower one, defeating the exhaustiveness check; the `v-if` guard placed on the child rather than the section then hides the gap and orphans the designed empty state.
defects.reproduction: `node scratchpad/probe2.mjs` then `node scratchpad/probe3.mjs`. Manually: load http://localhost:9000/, open the About pane's inline color-space selector, select any of srgb-linear / display-p3 / a98-rgb / prophoto-rgb / rec2020 / ictcp / jzazbz, scroll the About card to the bottom — the "Detailed Guide" h2 renders with ~90px of dead space beneath it and the card ends. Screenshot: scratchpad/about-p3-bottom.png.
defects.proposedCure: Delete `MarkdownSpace` and the cast; declare the table `satisfies Record<DisplayColorSpace, DocModule>` and write the 7 missing guides. If some spaces genuinely warrant no long-form guide, make that explicit as `Record<DisplayColorSpace, DocModule | null>` so the absence is a decision the compiler witnessed, and move the `v-if` off the heading so Markdown.vue's own Alert owns the empty case and becomes reachable.

defects.defect: One concept — the color-space set — is enumerated in four independent tables at four cardinalities across two trees, and the two AboutPane owns are the two with no totality mechanism. Unique semantic ownership is violated twice: structured facts and prose guides are both "the documentation of a color space", live in different trees, and disagree about which spaces exist.
defects.evidence: picker-color.ts:72-90 PICKER_SPACE_NAMES → color-model.ts:75-78 DISPLAY_COLOR_SPACE_NAMES = 18, enforced by `Readonly<Record<SpaceId,string>>`. picker-color.ts:52-70 PICKER_CHANNELS = 17, enforced by `satisfies Record<SpaceId, readonly ChannelMeta[]>`. colorSpaceInfo.ts:18-334 = 13, `as const`, unenforced. AboutPane.vue:81-93 markdownModules = 11, keyed on a private union, unenforced. colorSpaceInfo.ts:14-15's own header asserts the invariant it breaks: "Keys cover the `DisplayColorSpace` union" — it covers 13 of 18. Homes: demo/color-session/colorSpaceInfo.ts vs <repo-root>/assets/docs/*.md.
defects.mechanism: Duplicated domain enumeration with no single source of truth and no compiler join between the library's SpaceId and the demo's per-space content tables.
defects.reproduction: NONE — this is the structural root of L-1 and L-2, both of which are reproduced. Evidenced by direct enumeration of the four tables (grep of top-level keys in each file, counts above).
defects.proposedCure: One catalog module, `demo/scenes/about/spaces/index.ts`, exporting `SPACE_DOCS = { … } satisfies Record<DisplayColorSpace, { facts: SpaceFacts; guide: DocModule }>` — one table, one key type, the library's. Adding a SpaceId to @mkbabb/value.js/color then breaks the demo build until both halves exist. Ruling on placement, asked explicitly: this does NOT belong in src/ — 334 lines of English prose plus 11 markdown guides are not the business of a package described as "Immutable, failure-explicit CSS color... capabilities" and would tax every consumer. The demo pays for the prose, the library supplies the domain, the compiler joins them.

defects.defect: demo/ui/ is 19 directories containing 19 files, every one a bare one-line re-export of @mkbabb/glass-ui with zero local components. It is a pure aliasing layer that violates edict 2 (no aliases) and defeats edict 4 (glass-ui is the design system) with the same 19 files.
defects.evidence: `for d in demo/ui/*/; do echo "$(basename $d): $(ls $d)"; done` → all 19 (alert avatar badge button card checkbox collapsible dialog dropdown-menu input label popover radio-group select separator skeleton slider switch tooltip) contain only `index.ts`. demo/ui/card/index.ts is one line: `export { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`. demo/ui/separator/index.ts is one line: `export { Separator } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`. demo/ui/alert/index.ts's own comment records that its local shadcn re-implementation was already deleted — the directory was kept. AboutPane crosses it twice (AboutPane.vue:67,68); the closure crosses it five more times (ColorNutritionLabel.vue:173,175-179,181; Markdown.vue:35,36; ColorSpaceSelector.vue:109).
defects.mechanism: A shadow namespace over the design system. No component in the demo imports glass-ui by name, so a reader of AboutPane.vue:67 cannot tell `Separator` is a glass-ui primitive — and the pressure to add variants IN glass-ui, which is the entire reason edict 4 exists, never lands.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static, exhaustively enumerated by the command above (19/19).
defects.proposedCure: Delete demo/ui/ in full; rewrite the ~60 import sites to `@mkbabb/glass-ui` directly (and `@mkbabb/glass-ui/forms` for Input). Mechanical, removes 19 modules, and makes the design system visible at every call site. Larger than AboutPane alone — it is a tranche wave — but AboutPane cannot be called structurally sound while it depends on it.

defects.defect: tsconfig.demo.json's hand-rolled `paths` map is a second source of truth for the published surface and has drifted from package.json#exports: it names three keys that are not published and do not exist on disk (`.`, `/parsing`, `/units`) and omits two that are (`/value`, `/css` — the latter imported 10x in demo, twice inside AboutPane's closure). Its header comment documents an 8-key public API a real consumer cannot write.
defects.evidence: package.json#exports has 7 keys and no ".": color, value, css, easing, math, transform, quantize. tsconfig.demo.json:42-49 declares 8: "." → ./dist/index.d.ts, /color, /parsing, /math, /easing, /units, /transform, /quantize. `ls dist/index.d.ts` → absent; `ls dist/subpaths/` → color css easing math quantize transform value only (no parsing.d.ts, no units.d.ts). tsconfig.demo.json:4-8 states the demo "speaks only the 8 public keys" and names them — 3 of 8 are fiction. Contrast vite.config.ts:53-60: "GENERATED (not hand-rolled) so the alias set can never drift from the exports map" — the generated half didn't drift, the hand-rolled half did. `tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit --traceResolution` on @mkbabb/value.js/css (no paths entry) shows it already resolves the right way: "Found 'package.json' at '/Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js/package.json'. Entering conditional exports. Matched 'exports' condition 'types'. Using 'exports' subpath './css' with target './dist/subpaths/css.d.ts'." — package self-reference, exactly as an external consumer resolves it.
defects.mechanism: Two sources of truth for one published-surface map, only one of them generated. The redundant half drifted toward nonexistent files while the correct resolution mechanism (package self-reference through the real exports map) was already working underneath it.
defects.reproduction: `npx tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit --traceResolution | grep -B14 "Module name '@mkbabb/value.js/css' was successfully"` — prints the self-reference trace above; and `ls dist/index.d.ts dist/subpaths/parsing.d.ts dist/subpaths/units.d.ts` — all three absent.
defects.proposedCure: Delete all eight @mkbabb/value.js* entries from tsconfig.demo.json. Package self-reference then resolves the demo's types from the one exports map that vite.config.ts already generates its runtime aliases from — one source of truth for the published surface in both programs, dogfooded exactly as a consumer sees it. Adding or renaming a subpath propagates to types and runtime automatically, and an unpublished specifier fails loudly instead of resolving to a path that isn't there. (Related INFO: node_modules/@mkbabb/value.js is a real installed 4.0.0 tarball, auto-installed because glass-ui@7 peer-declares it, and is stale — css.d.ts inode 211668623 mtime Jul 17 21:10 vs dist/ inode 229536321 mtime Jul 27 11:52, ten days and two distinct files apart. Masked at runtime by the generated vite alias; vite.config.ts:50's "a package does not install itself" is false here.)

defects.defect: AboutPane's content lives at repo root outside demo/, and imports back into demo/ — a bidirectional boundary crossing. The 11 files in assets/docs/ are not assets: they are Vue SFCs with <script setup> blocks that happen to carry a .md extension.
defects.evidence: AboutPane.vue:82-92 dynamic-imports `../../../assets/docs/*.md` → <repo-root>/assets/docs/, a sibling of src/, outside demo/ entirely. `grep -rn "assets/docs" demo/ src/ test/ e2e/` returns only AboutPane.vue:82-92 — sole consumer in the repository. assets/docs/lab.md:1-3 is `<script setup>\nimport { Katex } from "../../demo/scenes/about/katex";\n</script>`; `grep -c "demo/scenes/about/katex" assets/docs/*.md` returns 1 for each of all 11 files. Full edge: demo/scenes/about/AboutPane.vue → assets/docs/lab.md → demo/scenes/about/katex/index.ts. They are compiled to SFCs by unplugin-vue-markdown (vite.config.ts:161).
defects.mechanism: Physical-home defect masked by a directory name. A demo scene reaches out of demo/ to a repo-root directory which reaches back into a private subdirectory of the very component that imported it.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static; exhaustively verified by the two greps above (sole consumer; 11/11 files carry the back-import).
defects.proposedCure: Move to demo/scenes/about/guides/<space>.md, beside the component that renders them and beside the katex/ they import. `../../demo/scenes/about/katex` becomes `../katex`; `../../../assets/docs/...` becomes `./guides/...`; the cycle across the demo/ boundary disappears and the About scene becomes self-contained — pane, label, markdown renderer, katex, facts and prose, one tree, one owner.

defects.defect: Markdown.vue is the only component in the entire demo that performs a runtime import of the shell's global stylesheets, and it duplicates the App-root import exactly — a leaf → shell boundary crossing pulled into the lazily-loaded About chunk.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/about/markdown/Markdown.vue:37-38 `import "../../../styles/foundation.css"; import "../../../styles/utils.css";`. Already imported at the root: demo/color-picker/App.vue:199-200 `import "../styles/utils.css"; import "../styles/foundation.css";`. Repo-wide grep for these two filenames returns 17 other component references and every one is `@reference` (Tailwind compile-time directive, emits nothing) — including Markdown.vue:79 itself, which already carries the correct `@reference "../../../styles/foundation.css"`. AboutPane is defineAsyncComponent-loaded (usePaneRouter.ts:69), so these side-effect imports enter the About async chunk's graph.
defects.mechanism: Global style ownership belongs to the app root; a component three levels inside a lazily-loaded pane re-declaring it is a leaf reaching up into the shell.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static; `grep -rn "foundation.css|utils.css" demo/` shows Markdown.vue:37-38 as the sole runtime-import site among 19 references.
defects.proposedCure: Delete Markdown.vue:37-38. The `@reference` at :79 is what the scoped @apply rules actually need and is already present.

defects.defect: AboutPane is the last prop-drilled pane in a shell that was deliberately transposed to ambient injection, and the two paths carry different values: the prop cssColor is alpha-bearing while the injected CSS_COLOR_KEY is alpha-stripped, with the default model at 82.7% alpha.
defects.evidence: usePaneRouter.ts:146-152 hand-builds `{ modelValue: model.value, "onUpdate:modelValue": …, cssColor: deps.cssColor() }` inside an untyped `Record<string, unknown>`. usePaneRouter.ts:135-137 records the picker's opposite treatment: "S.W2 · W2-1: the picker no longer takes the model as a prop — it injects the ONE pipeline (COLOR_MODEL_KEY) App provides." AboutPane's own comment at :7-19 confirms its subtree already reads that ambient pipeline; ColorSpaceSelector.vue:139 injects COLOR_MODEL_KEY, ColorNutritionLabel.vue:188 injects CSS_COLOR_KEY. The divergence: App.vue:340 passes `cssColor: () => cssColor.value` (alpha-bearing) while App.vue:271 does `provide(CSS_COLOR_KEY, cssColorOpaque)` (alpha-stripped). Default model is `lab(92% 88.8 20 / 82.70%)` (color-model.ts:43), α=0.827 — confirmed live, REPORT.json safari-desktop-light /#/ records boot URL `?space=lab&color=lab(92%25+88.8+20+/+82.7%25)`. ColorSpaceSelector.vue:83 binds the prop live to `<WatercolorDot :color="cssColor">`.
defects.mechanism: Dual state path — prop/emit AND provide/inject for one concept — which additionally forces demo/shell/ to know a leaf component's private prop shape. Honestly scoped: useMarkdownColors.ts:39 destructures only [L, C, H] and discards alpha, so the divergence is visually inert in that one consumer today. Latent correctness fault, not a current rendering defect.
defects.reproduction: NONE for a visible symptom — labelled a latent fault. The value divergence is proven statically by App.vue:271 vs :340 plus the α=0.827 default measured in the live boot URL.
defects.proposedCure: Drop modelValue/cssColor from usePaneRouter.rightProps; let AboutPane inject COLOR_MODEL_KEY and CSS_COLOR_KEY the way the picker already does. rightProps then collapses to the palettes case alone and the shell stops knowing any pane's prop shape — state flows one direction, App provides and panes inject, so no two routes for one value can disagree about alpha.

defects.defect: A vite plugin and an alias run in every build mode, kept alive by a comment whose sole cited justification is AboutPane's asset tree — and that justification is false at HEAD: there are zero `?source` and zero `@src` references in assets/ or demo/.
defects.evidence: vite.config.ts:159-160 registers `sourceExportPlugin()` in defaultPlugins, spread by all three build modes; vite.config.ts:74 keeps the `@src` alias, justified at :70-73 as surviving "for the EXEMPT `assets/docs/*.md` reference pages, which embed live source snippets via `@src/…?source` (the `sourceExportPlugin`)". Measured: `grep -rn "?source" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=dist --exclude-dir=.git .` → zero hits in assets/, demo/, src/; only plugins/vite-source-export.ts itself, the vite.config.ts comment, and tranche-N/G audit prose. `grep -rn "@src/" demo/` → zero hits. AboutPane is the sole consumer of the asset tree the comment names.
defects.mechanism: Dead build infrastructure retained by a stale comment; the plugin executes on every dev serve and every build for no consumer.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static; the two greps above return zero hits in the cited locations.
defects.proposedCure: Delete plugins/vite-source-export.ts, its import at vite.config.ts:13, its registration at :160, and the `@src` alias at :74. Keep vitest.config.ts:11's `@src` alias — it is separate and live, used by 5 files under test/.

defects.defect: An `any` annotation in a template handler widens an already-typed emit into an untyped write on the domain model — the second type hole in a 100-line file.
defects.evidence: AboutPane.vue:24: `@update:model-value="(colorSpace: any) => { model = { ...model, selectedColorSpace: colorSpace }; }"`. ColorSpaceSelector.vue:145-147 already declares `emit<{ "update:modelValue": [value: string] }>` and the target field is typed `DisplayColorSpace` (color-model.ts:36-41).
defects.mechanism: Unnecessary type widening at a component boundary that is already typed on both sides.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static, file:line above.
defects.proposedCure: Narrow the selector's emit to `[value: DisplayColorSpace]` — free, since ColorSpaceSelector.vue:150 already builds its options from DISPLAY_COLOR_SPACE_NAMES — and drop the annotation at AboutPane.vue:24 entirely.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation defect hunt on demo/scenes/about/AboutPane.vue (the component is assumed improperly implemented; find the bugs)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id claude-opus-5[1m]; the tier explicitly declared at spawn, not inherited
result.strongestDefect: C-1 — one failed markdown document fetch destroys the ENTIRE application. `Markdown.vue:58-62` awaits AboutPane's dynamic-import thunk with no try/catch, from an async `onMounted` (`:69-71`); Vue routes the rejection through `callWithAsyncErrorHandling` into the error chain, and the nearest `onErrorCaptured` is `ErrorBoundary.vue:59`, which wraps the WHOLE two-pane grid (`App.vue:50`…`:140`). Aborting exactly one request (`assets/docs/lab.md`) yields `{"boundaryPresent":true,"pickerPresent":false,"aboutPresent":false}` — the color picker dies with the prose. Markdown.vue already ships the correct "Oh snap… We couldn't find the documentation" Alert at `:19-31`; it is unreachable on this path.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. (Per-hazard negative proofs are recorded in the report's "Negative proofs" table: zero rAF/listener/observer/timer sites in AboutPane.vue by grep; no WebGL; no ValueUnit wrapping; no reka slider; no HSV/stableHue involvement; both type-only imports correctly `import type` (`:68`,`:70`); focus correctly restored to the trigger after the Select closes; the only About tap target measures 152x48 and the 52x21 prose link is WCAG-2.5.8-exempt as an inline link; About contributes 0 of the 8 small tap targets in REPORT.json for `/#/`; the per-drag long-task A/B shows NO measurable penalty (70ms with About vs 82ms without), so the C-9 perf claim is explicitly declared NOT SUBSTANTIATED; and the two space-change write paths are behaviourally identical today, so C-5's clobber is labelled a HYPOTHESIS.)

defects.defect: Unguarded dynamic import: one failed markdown doc fetch tears down the entire application, not the pane. The child's own designed not-found Alert is unreachable.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/about/markdown/Markdown.vue:58-62 (no try/catch) + :69-71 (async onMounted) → demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:59 (onErrorCaptured) wrapping demo/color-picker/App.vue:50…:140 (the whole two-pane grid). Measured: `B2: {"boundaryPresent": true, "boundaryText": "This panel hit an unexpected error. Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: http://localhost:9000/@fs/.../assets/docs/lab.md?import Try again", "role": "alert", "pickerPresent": false, "aboutPresent": false, "canvases": 1}`. Screenshot scratchpad/about-chunkfail.png shows the whole product replaced by a lone Try again pill. Dead empty state at Markdown.vue:19-31.
defects.mechanism: The doc load is an imperative mount-time side effect with no failure arm, so the rejection escapes to an app-scoped error boundary; failure has no home at the level that owns it.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/about-probe3.mjs (or about-probe4.mjs). Playwright: page.route('**/*', r => /lab\.md/.test(r.request().url()) ? r.abort('failed') : r.continue()); goto http://localhost:9000/#/?space=lab&color=lab(50%25%2020%2020); wait 6s; evaluate → .picker-shell and .about-card are both null, .vj-error-boundary is present.
defects.proposedCure: Stop treating the doc as a mount event and state it as a resource: replace onMounted+ref with a watchEffect over the `module` prop producing a discriminated union {status:'loading'|'ready'|'failed'}, with 'failed' rendering the Alert that already exists in the file. This single transposition also discharges C-2's dead error path and C-6's load-bearing :key.

defects.defect:
The hand-maintained MarkdownSpace table covers 11 of 18 selectable color spaces; the other 7 render `

Detailed Guide

` with literally nothing under it, and the child's not-found Alert is pre-empted by AboutPane's v-if.
defects.evidence:
AboutPane.vue:79 (11-member union), :81-93 (table), :97 (`markdownModules[... as MarkdownSpace]` — the cast defeats exhaustiveness), :51 (`v-if="activeMarkdownModule"` pre-empts Markdown.vue:19-31). Domain: color-model.ts:29 `DisplayColorSpace = PickerSpace | "hex"`; picker-color.ts:72-89 PICKER_SPACE_NAMES has 17 entries → 18 selectable. Missing: srgb-linear, display-p3, a98-rgb, prophoto-rgb, rec2020, ictcp, jzazbz. Measured: `=== space: display-p3 === {"triggerText":"Display P3", "guideBodyLen":14, "hasMarkdownBody":false}` (14 chars = the heading alone); rec2020 identical. Rendered DOM: `

Detailed Guide

`.
defects.mechanism: A hand-maintained partial table over an open domain type, with an `as` cast suppressing the exhaustiveness check TypeScript would otherwise enforce — the table silently drifts as the domain grows.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/about-probe.mjs — navigate http://localhost:9000/#/?space=display-p3&color=color(display-p3%200.5%200.2%200.7), wait 3.5s, read the 'Detailed Guide' h2's parentElement: guideBodyLen 14, hasMarkdownBody false. Same for ?space=rec2020.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the MarkdownSpace union and the cast; type the table `Partial<Record<DisplayColorSpace, DocModule>>`, drop the v-if, and pass `:module` straight through so `Markdown` owns its own absence via the Alert it already ships. Exhaustiveness then lives in the type and the missing-doc answer lives in the one component that renders it.

defects.defect: For the same 7 spaces, ColorNutritionLabel's `?? colorSpaceInfo.rgb` fallback renders RGB's dossier as though it were the selected space's — factually false color science, presented with full editorial confidence.
defects.evidence: AboutPane.vue:43 mounts the label on the same model; ColorNutritionLabel.vue:210-215 `return space in colorSpaceInfo ? colorSpaceInfo[...] : colorSpaceInfo.rgb;`. colorSpaceInfo.ts has 10 space keys (rgb hsl hsv hwb lab lch oklab oklch xyz kelvin). Visual proof scratchpad/about-display-p3.png with Display P3 selected: Definition 'A color space based on the additive mixture of red, green, and blue light.' (RGB's), White Point 'Varies (typically D65)' (Display P3 is fixed D65), Gamut 'Limited (device-specific)' (Display P3 is a standardized gamut), Created '1931' (Display P3 is 2015; DCI-P3 2010; 1931 is CIE RGB).
defects.mechanism: A masking fallback that substitutes a DIFFERENT subject's data rather than signalling absence — the same partial-table-over-open-domain mechanism as C-2, but with a wrong-answer rather than an empty-answer consequence.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/about-probe.mjs then read scratchpad/about-display-p3.png; or navigate http://localhost:9000/#/?space=display-p3&color=color(display-p3%200.5%200.2%200.7) and read the Definition / White Point / Gamut / Created rows in the right pane.
defects.proposedCure: Make colorSpaceInfo `Record<DisplayColorSpace, SpaceInfo>` with no partial and no fallback, so a missing row is a compile error. Then either write the 7 dossiers or remove the 7 spaces from the picker — both are honest; `?? rgb` is not.

defects.defect: Vacuous gate: no unit test exists for AboutPane/ColorNutritionLabel/Markdown, and every e2e assertion about the About pane runs at exactly one color space (`lab`). The feature can lose 17 of 18 spaces with the suite fully green.
defects.evidence: `grep -rln "AboutPane|ColorNutritionLabel|scenes/about" demo/test test` → no output. e2e/smoke/oracles/o10-type-locks.spec.ts:66-117 asserts only computed type on `.about-card .space-trigger`. e2e/smoke/mobile/walk.spec.ts:103,113,125 asserts only that the heading 'Detailed Guide' is visible — exactly what survives C-2. e2e/smoke/oracles/o18-contrast-census.spec.ts:745-777 is the only spec asserting `.markdown-wrapper .markdown-body` visible, and it boots OWNER_URL, pinned at `:70` to `"/#/?space=lab&color=" + encodeURIComponent(OWNER_COLOR)`. The visual matrix inherits the blind spot: REPORT.json results[].probe.url for /#/ is `?space=lab&color=lab(92%25+88.8+20+/+82.7%25)`.
defects.mechanism: Gates assert on the frame (typography, heading presence, one boot color) rather than on the product of the table, so table drift is invisible by construction.
defects.reproduction: NONE (this is a gate-coverage finding). Exact green-keeping mutation: reduce AboutPane.vue:79-93 to `type MarkdownSpace = "lab";` with a single-entry table. 17 of 18 spaces then render a bare heading; o10 stays green (type only), walk stays green (heading survives), o18 stays green (boots at lab) — full suite GREEN with 94% of the feature dead.
defects.proposedCure: One table-driven spec that iterates DISPLAY_COLOR_SPACE_NAMES and asserts, for every key, that the Detailed Guide section contains either a `.markdown-body` or the not-found Alert — never a lone heading. ~12 lines, and the table can never drift silently again.

defects.defect: The space-change handler is typed `any`, does a read-modify-write on an uncached `defineModel` computed, and sends a whole-model snapshot into a Partial-merging setter — a second, divergent write path for the same action the picker performs correctly with one field.
defects.evidence: AboutPane.vue:25 `@update:model-value="(colorSpace: any) => { model = { ...model, selectedColorSpace: colorSpace }; }"` with `defineModel<ColorModel>({required:true})` at :72 and NO local shallowRef cache (owner edict 7 names both the hazard and the cure). Prop lands at usePaneRouter.ts:148-151 → useColorPipeline.ts:59-70 whose contract is `Partial<ColorModel>`. The correct sibling: ColorPicker.vue:43 `@update:model-value="(colorSpace: any) => updateModel({ selectedColorSpace: colorSpace })"`.
defects.mechanism: The pane is wired through the router as a snapshot-passing v-model instead of injecting COLOR_MODEL_KEY, which is already provided app-wide and already injected inside this very subtree (ColorSpaceSelector.vue:142) — so a one-field intent is expressed as a whole-model overwrite of a possibly-stale copy.
defects.reproduction: NONE for the clobber — labelled a HYPOTHESIS. Probed and NOT reproduced: node scratchpad/about-probe5.mjs → `--- change space via ABOUT dropdown --- after: url …space=oklch… aboutTrigger "OKLCh" pickerTrigger "OKLCh"` vs `--- change space via PICKER dropdown --- after:` identical. Real pointer events land in separate tasks so props always flush between them. The `any`, the missing shallowRef cache, and the dual write path are CONFIRMED by source.
defects.proposedCure: Inject COLOR_MODEL_KEY and call `updateModel({ selectedColorSpace })`. The defineModel and the router's modelValue/onUpdate:modelValue prop pair (usePaneRouter.ts:146-152) both disappear — one write path, no snapshot, no `any`, no stale window to reason about.

defects.defect: `:key="model.selectedColorSpace"` is load-bearing correctness disguised as an optimisation: Markdown.vue loads its doc only in onMounted and never watches its `module` prop, so removing the key freezes the guide on the first space forever.
defects.evidence: AboutPane.vue:52 `:key="model.selectedColorSpace"`; Markdown.vue:58-62 `loadDocs` is called only from :69-71 `onMounted`; whole-file read confirms no `watch(() => module, …)` exists. Shipped consequences: every space change discards the rendered doc, flashes the skeleton (Markdown.vue:3-9), re-runs the TreeWalker pass, and loses position in a 7523px scroller (measured: `about-card scroll meta: {"scrollHeight":7523,"clientHeight":830}`).
defects.mechanism: Reactivity implemented as remount — the child's data is a function of a mount event rather than of its input, so the parent must destroy it to update it.
defects.reproduction: NONE at runtime (the failing repro requires deleting AboutPane.vue:52, which this seat may not edit). CONFIRMED by source: no watcher on `module` exists anywhere in Markdown.vue.
defects.proposedCure: Subsumed by C-1's cure: a watchEffect on `module` makes the doc a function of its input, after which the `:key` carries no meaning and can be deleted safely.

defects.defect: The asynchronous Detailed-Guide swap (skeleton → prose) is never announced; the About card contains zero aria-live/status regions.
defects.evidence: Measured, scratchpad/about-probe5.mjs: `before: {"ariaLiveInAbout":0, …}` / `after : {"ariaLiveInAbout":0, …}` — `document.querySelectorAll('.about-card [aria-live]').length === 0` both before and after a space change. WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.3 Status Messages (AA). Focus itself is correct: activeElement after selection is the trigger BUTTON.
defects.mechanism: An async content region with no status role — the change is perceivable only visually.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/about-probe5.mjs — click .about-card .space-trigger, pick OKLCh, then evaluate document.querySelectorAll('.about-card [aria-live]').length → 0.
defects.proposedCure: `role="status"` on the guide's CardContent (AboutPane.vue:48), letting skeleton/prose/Alert transition inside it. One attribute at the section root — no wrapper component, no new shared dir.

defects.defect: Inverted heading outline: the pane title is an h3 while all six of the pane's section headings are h2, and the document contains zero h1.
defects.evidence:
PaneHeader.vue:26 renders `

`; AboutPane.vue:49 renders `

Detailed Guide

`; ColorNutritionLabel.vue:18,43,71,93,149 render five more h2. Measured outline (about-probe6.mjs): `"outline": "H3,H3,H2,H2,H2,H2,H2,H2,H3,H3,H2,H3,H3,H3,H2,H3,H3,H2,H3,H3,H2"`. h1 count 0 — independently confirmed by the repo's own harness: REPORT.json results[].probe.counts.h1 = 0 across all 60 captures. capture.mjs:119 records counts.h1 but the summary at :236-243 never asserts on it, so the number was measured and never read.

defects.defect: AboutPane forwards the raw per-frame `cssColor` into the prose subtree instead of the rAF-coalesced signal the pipeline already publishes: 285 style-attribute writes on .markdown-wrapper during one 4.2s slider drag, each preceded by a full parse → oklch convert → certifyAccentInk (gamut map + WCAG floor walk) recompute and followed by an onUpdated TreeWalker re-entry.
defects.evidence: AboutPane.vue:54 `:cssColor="cssColor"`, fed from usePaneRouter.ts:150 `cssColor: deps.cssColor()`; useMarkdownColors.ts:33-88 does the recompute; Markdown.vue:73-75 `onUpdated(() => applyHighlighting())`. Measured (about-probe3.mjs, MutationObserver attributeFilter ['style'] on .markdown-wrapper): `C. 60 pointer moves in 4192 ms → {"mdStyleMutations":285}`. The coalesced alternative exists and is unused: useColorPipeline.ts:279 `cssColorOpaqueFrame`, whose composable header (useAtmosphereFrameCoalesce.ts:14-19) states the intent verbatim ('SYNCHRONOUSLY on EVERY cssColorOpaque change, i.e. 60x/s under a slider drag').
defects.mechanism: The pane is wired to the synchronous readout signal where its content is atmosphere — the seam is one level too raw, so a per-frame signal drives a per-frame certified-ink derivation in a prose subtree.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/about-probe3.mjs (section C). PERF CLAIM NOT SUBSTANTIATED — the A/B in about-probe4.mjs shows no penalty: `C2-A (right pane = About): {"longTaskMs":70,"longTasks":1}` vs `C2-B (right pane = Palettes): {"longTaskMs":82,"longTasks":1}`. The churn is structural, not measurably expensive.
defects.proposedCure: Feed the About subtree `cssColorOpaqueFrame` — the prose ink is atmosphere, not readout, and belongs on the atmosphere clock the pipeline already runs.

defects.defect: The 11-entry markdownModules table plus its 11 closures is rebuilt on every component instance instead of living at module scope, where it is a compile-time constant.
defects.evidence: AboutPane.vue:81-93 declares the Record inside `<script setup>`. The pane is defineAsyncComponent-mounted and re-created on every view switch (usePaneRouter.ts:69).
defects.mechanism: A constant placed in instance scope — allocation per mount for a value that never varies.
defects.reproduction: NONE (static reading; allocation is not user-visible). AboutPane.vue:81 is inside the setup block by inspection.
defects.proposedCure: Hoist markdownModules above the setup block to module scope so it is allocated once per chunk.

defects.defect: The pane scroll/overflow/sizing recipe is a verbatim per-instance duplicate across eight panes, and the eight disagree about `mx-auto` with no one having chosen the difference.

defects.defect: The sticky pane header does not occlude. Body ink at computed opacity 1 prints through it — two type layers simultaneously readable — and the scroll fade washes out content the header does NOT cover while preserving content it does.

Measured (ABD-final.mjs) elements intersecting the sticky band at computed opacity 1: scroll 0 → 0; scroll 120 → 2 (max overlap 40.0px); scroll 420 → 8 (max 30.5px); scroll 900 → 6 (max 35.9px). defects.mechanism: The choreography scrubs the wrong quantity: the fill's own alpha is 0.65, so at opacity:1 the layer is still 65% opaque and 35% of the underlying ink transmits — no value of the animated property can make it opaque. The backdrop-filter that would rescue it is defeated by .pane-scroll-fade's `contain: layout style paint` (PaneHeader.vue:54-57, measured live as contain: content), which makes the pane its own paint-containment root. Either make the header an honest occluder (opaque at the plate tone from frame zero; the scrub carries only elevation/size), or — preferred under D-1/D-2 — make About a document-scrolling article with no sticky header at all, which VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §3 law 6 already mandates for the narrow arm. That kills the double exposure, the mismatched fade band, and the 10.4-screen nested scroller together.

defects.defect: 7 of 18 selectable color spaces render "Detailed Guide" as a heading over a void, and Markdown.vue's designed "Oh snap…" empty state is rendered permanently dead by its only consumer's v-if.

Missing: srgb-linear, display-p3, a98-rgb, prophoto-rgb, rec2020, ictcp, jzazbz = 7/18 = 38.9%. Selecting Display P3 live: {title: "About the color spaces, Display P3", guideHeadingPresent: true, guideBodyChars: 0, guideSectionHeight: 133.1, markdownMounted: false, ohSnapAlert: false, scrollH: 1250 (was 8023 — 84% of the pane silently vanishes)}. Frame scratchpad/ABD-display-p3-guide.png shows a 33px bold Fraunces "Detailed Guide" as the terminal element with nothing beneath it.
defects.mechanism:
Two compounding decisions. (1) AboutPane.vue:79 declares a hand-written 11-member `type MarkdownSpace` instead of the domain's DisplayColorSpace, and :96-98 casts through it (`markdownModules[model.value.selectedColorSpace as MarkdownSpace]`) — the cast exists to silence the exhaustiveness error that Record would raise. (2) AboutPane.vue:51 `v-if="activeMarkdownModule"` guarantees Markdown.vue:19-29's designed error Alert never mounts. The

Detailed Guide

at :49 sits OUTSIDE the v-if, so the promise is unconditional and the delivery is not.
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/ → About title selector → Display P3 (or sRGB Linear / Adobe RGB / ProPhoto RGB / Rec. 2020 / ICtCp / Jzazbz) → scroll to the bottom of the About card. Or: node scratchpad/ABD-states.mjs → out.afterDisplayP3.
defects.proposedCure: Type the map Record<DisplayColorSpace, DocModule> so the compiler enumerates the seven holes, then close them honestly: author the missing docs, or make the section a real state machine (content | not-yet-documented) that renders Markdown.vue's existing empty state. Never a heading whose body is conditional.

defects.defect: 5 of 18 color spaces are described with sRGB's facts under their own name — definition, white point, gamut, creation year, components, key properties and conversion graph — with no annotation and no visual distinction from the truthful rows.
defects.evidence: ColorNutritionLabel.vue:210-215: `return space in colorSpaceInfo ? colorSpaceInfo[space as keyof typeof colorSpaceInfo] : colorSpaceInfo.rgb;`. colorSpaceInfo has 13 keys (rgb hsl hsv hwb lab lch oklab oklch xyz kelvin ictcp jzazbz hex); missing srgb-linear, display-p3, a98-rgb, prophoto-rgb, rec2020 = 5/18. defects.mechanism: A ternary fallback to a default record — exactly the pattern owner edict #2 forbids ("no masking fallbacks"). It converts a missing-data state into a wrong-data state, which is strictly worse: missing data is visible, wrong data is not. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §7 states the general law for this product: "absence is never filled by inference."
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/ → About selector → Display P3 / Adobe RGB / ProPhoto RGB / Rec. 2020 / sRGB Linear. Read the Conversion Graph against the pane title.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the fallback; type colorSpaceInfo as Record<DisplayColorSpace, ColorSpaceInfo> so the five holes are compile errors, and fill them with real data. A pane whose entire job is being right about color science may not guess. (ColorNutritionLabel has its own seat; recorded here because AboutPane.vue:43 is its sole host and the lie is only visible under this title.)

defects.defect: In dark mode the inline title selector becomes optically identical to the sentence around it: the affordance's chromatic separation drops from 2.41:1 to 1.09:1, leaving a ~12px chevron as the only cue that a word is a control.

Dark: trigger color(srgb 1 0.924654 0.933001 / .86), title rgb(233,230,226) → 1.09:1. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4.1: "Selected, failed, pending, withdrawn and disabled states are never color-only" and "Text, focus, boundaries and state meet their rendered contrast on the actual material tier; a token name is not evidence." The token is present in both schemes; the rendered separation is not.

Separately, `grep -rn "forced-colors|prefers-reduced-motion|prefers-contrast" demo/scenes/about/ demo/shared/ui/PaneHeader.vue` → no output, while Markdown.vue:124 `transition: color var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-standard)` and ColorNutritionLabel.vue:105 `transition-colors` are time-based.
defects.mechanism: The :key remount discards a mounted subtree and restarts its async load, so the guide collapses to ~64px and re-expands to ~6851px on every selection — a full-slab hole. The skeleton's shape (avatar + 2 lines) belongs to a comment/list component, not a long-form article.
defects.reproduction: SHAPE AND REMOUNT: CONFIRMED by source plus the measured 6851.2px vs ~64px. VISIBLE BLANK FRAME: HYPOTHESIS — ABD-final.mjs sampled at 0/16/33/66/120/300ms after a space change and found md:true, guideChars:4041 at every sample because Vite's dev server had the .md chunk in module cache. Reproducible in principle on a cold production chunk fetch; I am not claiming a frame I did not capture. The missing a11y media rules are grep-definitive.
defects.proposedCure: Drop :key and let the module swap inside a stable instance; if a pending state is needed it must be article-shaped at the article's own reserved height. Add the forced-colors treatment at the producer, not per instance; gate the two color transitions.

defects.defect: Two ColorSpaceSelector instances render simultaneously on /#/ desktop, both owning the same selection.

PROPORTION-AUDIT PR-06: "duplicated selected fills — REMOVE — One action/selection owner"; VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §1 "one primary action instrument" per screen.

defects.defect: Design-system boundary and dead-utility residue: four glass-ui primitives reached for the wrong semantics and then corrected per instance; one inert utility class; two type casts that make D-8's hole compile.
defects.evidence: AboutPane.vue:2 Card as page primitive (VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §3.1 forbids); ColorNutritionLabel.vue:8 Alert for static lead copy plus four per-instance corrections `class="m-0 bg-well border-border/30 rounded-card"`; ColorNutritionLabel.vue:92-112 Tooltip around ordered data on a non-focusable cursor-pointer div; AboutPane.vue:49 `class="font-display text-title"` — a per-instance type override of a role the closed matrix already assigns (owner edict #5: style at the root). AboutPane.vue:4 `w-full mx-auto` — mx-auto is inert at width:100%. AboutPane.vue:25 `(colorSpace: any)` and :97 `as MarkdownSpace`.
defects.mechanism: When a component needs four overrides to stop looking like itself, it is the wrong component. The two casts are the type-level seam through which the seven undocumented spaces enter unchecked.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownership, dependency direction, public surface)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m]) — matches the explicit declaration this seat was spawned with; no inherited or undeclared seat.
result.strongestDefect: L-1 — 4 of the 5 Geometry sliders on /#/blob are provably inert: HeroBlob.vue:152-178 hard-writes bodyRadius/orbitRadius/satelliteRadius/eccentricity as literals after spreading the injected config, so the pane's readout is a lie about the only <Blob> in the app. Measured: pane shows 0.450/0.480/0.200/0.500, the component receives 0.325/0.4/0.09/0.03.
result.negativeProof: Not SOUND, but six claims were tested and refuted, and are recorded as negative proofs in the report: (1) ZERO deep-path imports — `grep -rn "@src/" demo | grep -v assets/docs` and `grep -rn 'from "[./]*\.\./src/' demo` both return nothing; every value.js import in the demo is a bare published subpath resolved by a vite alias set GENERATED from package.json#exports (vite.config.ts:41-49), so the public surface cannot drift. (2) No duplicate OKLCh stack — node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/color.js line 3 imports convertColor/interpolateHue/mapColorToGamut/toRgba8 from "@mkbabb/value.js/color"; value.js IS dogfooded transitively. (3) No bundle-size defect — Rollup tree-shakes both the 103KB glass-ui/blob barrel and the root barrel to byte-identical output (0.08 kB vs 0.08 kB; 0.15 kB vs 0.15 kB), so L-5 and L-7 are structural only, not perf. (4) verbatimModuleSyntax clean — BlobPane.vue:13,15 are both `import type`. (5) The three-parallel-useDark suspect is dead: 18 useGlobalDark hits, zero vueuse useDark. (6) The cqi row-rhythm claim is honest — demo/styles/shell.css:83 sets container-type: inline-size on .pane-wrapper. No a11y/PRM finding was manufactured (the 39 desktop tap targets are density on a fine-pointer matrix; no two-engine repro obtained, none claimed).

defects.defect: Four of BlobPane's five Geometry sliders (and surface.fissionAmp, and color.paletteStops) never reach the renderer: HeroBlob.vue hard-writes literals after spreading the injected config, and it passes that object as the `config` PROP, which the producer's `config ?? injectedConfig` seam prefers outright. The pane's own header (BlobPane.vue:19-21) claims a compile-time guard against 'silently no-op'ing a slider' — the guard is type-level and cannot see an override authored in a different component.
defects.evidence: demo/picker/visual/HeroBlob.vue:152-178 (`geometry: { ...appBlobConfig.geometry, bodyRadius: 0.325, orbitRadius: 0.4, satelliteRadius: 0.09, eccentricity: 0.03 }`) and HeroBlob.vue:13-19 (`<Blob :config="heroConfig">`); only one <Blob> exists in the demo (`grep -rn '<Blob\b' demo` → HeroBlob.vue:13). MEASURED via scratchpad/probe/props.mjs against the live dev server, reading props.config off the Blob instance through __vueParentComponent: `pane rows: Body Radius0.450 | Orbit Radius0.480 | Sat Radius0.200 | Eccentricity0.500 | Satellites4 | Warp1` vs `delivered to <Blob>: {"geometry":{"canvasSize":200,"bodyRadius":0.325,"satelliteCount":4,"satelliteRadius":0.09,"orbitRadius":0.4,"eccentricity":0.03},"surfaceFission":0.6,"membraneWarp":1}`. satelliteCount and warpAmp passing through prove the write mechanism itself works. Corroborated by docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/blob.png (pane prints 0.220, bead renders 0.325). SECOND repro: with the blob parked (BLOB_IDLE_MS 2000 + SLEEPY_POSE_MS 3300, HeroBlob.vue:211-225) four screenshots after Body-Radius-max, Satellites-max and Reset are byte-identical — sha256 1b24742e25fb3f534b028a983b241e18259d60c3939443421ee753667e0cc89e for all of hero-A/B/C/D.png — because noteBlobActivity() (HeroBlob.vue:216) is wired only to cssColorOpaque and savedColorStrings.length and has no idea a tuning pane exists.
defects.mechanism: A preset/override layer authored as literals inside a leaf view component instead of as data in the config module. glass-ui publishes both the concept (`ConfiguratorPreset<T>`) and a concrete blob hero preset (`BLOB_HERO`, glass-ui/dist/presets-5myqNv59.js, exported from ./blob-config) — `grep -rn 'BLOB_HERO' demo src test e2e` returns NOTHING, and the demo maintains a divergent second hero register inline (producer: orbitRadius 0.3 / satRadius 0.1 / ecc 0.04 / satCount 4 / smoothK 0.06; demo: bodyRadius 0.325 / orbitRadius 0.4 / satRadius 0.09 / ecc 0.03). Two hero registers alive = dual path.
defects.reproduction: Dev server at localhost:9000. `node scratchpad/probe/props.mjs` — loads /#/blob, drives Body Radius / Orbit Radius / Sat Radius / Eccentricity / Satellites / Warp to their maxima with the End key, then prints the pane readouts beside the config object actually delivered to the <Blob> component instance. Four rows diverge; two agree.
defects.proposedCure: Architectural transposition: the tuning pane must own its own stage and its own preset table. Replace ConfigSliderPane with glass-ui's shipped `<Configurator>`: `:presets="[{key:'default',config:BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS},{key:'hero',config:BLOB_HERO}]"` + `#stage` slot rendering its own <Blob> + `<ConfiguratorLayer>` per section. HeroBlob then SELECTS the 'hero' preset instead of hand-patching four keys. The readout becomes true by construction because the pane renders the blob it tunes.

defects.defect: glass-ui ships a complete Configurator surface (Configurator, ConfiguratorLayer, ConfiguratorRow, useConfiguratorState, CONFIGURATOR_SIZE_KEY, ConfiguratorPreset, ConfiguratorScrollMode) and the demo consumes exactly ONE of its seven exports, hand-rebuilding the rest as a 253-line demo-local component. Owner edict 4 violation (glass-ui is the design system).
defects.evidence: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/configurator.d.ts lists 7 export groups. `grep -rn 'useConfiguratorState|ConfiguratorLayer|<Configurator' demo` → zero hits; only demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:21 imports ConfiguratorRow. The rebuild map: section grouping = ConfiguratorLayer/layers prop vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:128-131 + :232-243; scroll port = scrollMode="auto" (FadingScroll) vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:106 .pane-scroll-fade; footer+reset = #footer slot with `reset` + @reset emit vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:163-174 + :245-251; row density = `size: sm|md|lg` cascading via CONFIGURATOR_SIZE_KEY vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:215-217 `:deep(.configurator-row){min-block-size:clamp(...)}`; reset/dirty/presets = useConfiguratorState<T> (resetCurrent, isDirty, selectPreset, clone hook) vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:92-94 Object.assign. ConfiguratorRow's own doc block credits 'the double-label API (value.js L14)' — the coordination channel that put it in the producer was used once, then abandoned.
defects.mechanism: Design-system component duplicated in the consumer; the demo-local copy then becomes the home of defects the producer surface had already solved (see L-3).
defects.reproduction: `cat node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/configurator.d.ts` then `grep -rn 'useConfiguratorState\|ConfiguratorLayer\|<Configurator' demo` (zero hits) against demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue (253 lines).
defects.proposedCure: Delete demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue outright. Move both consumers (BlobPane, AuroraPane) onto <Configurator> + <ConfiguratorLayer> + useConfiguratorState. Every row in the rebuild map above disappears with it, including the hand-rolled reset that causes L-3 and the :deep() overrides of L-8.

defects.defect: ConfigSliderPane's Reset performs a SHALLOW Object.assign over an 8-atom NESTED config, so it replaces `config.color` wholesale — destroying `color.paletteStops`, an atom BlobPane deliberately does not expose and useAtmosphere owns and writes.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:92-94 `function resetDefaults(){ Object.assign(config, structuredClone(defaults)); }`. BlobPane.vue:8-9 declares paletteStops 'the live picker-palette feed ... not a slider'. Writer is demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:390-403 (a watch on atmosphereColor). MEASURED via scratchpad/probe/injected.mjs on the live server: INJECTED blobConfig BEFORE reset = ["#ffbde0","#ffdde5","#fff6f6","#fff6f4"] (4 live pink stops); AFTER Reset = ["#b5947f","#d4b27d","#dad6b1"] — the 3 canned brown literals baked into BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS.color.paletteStops (glass-ui/dist/presets-5myqNv59.js). It stays clobbered because the writer is a colour watch and Reset does not change the colour.
defects.mechanism: Hand-rolled reset (L-2) over a nested config, combined with split ownership of a single atom: paletteStops has a writer in boot and a blind resetter in a scene component. The bug is invisible today ONLY because L-1 masks it (the sole <Blob> overrides paletteStops with its own derivation) — two defects cancelling, not a working system.
defects.reproduction: `node scratchpad/probe/injected.mjs` — loads /#/blob, reads the provided Symbol(blobConfig).color.paletteStops off the component tree, clicks Reset, re-reads. 4 live stops become 3 canned browns.
defects.proposedCure: useConfiguratorState<T>.resetCurrent() with its `clone` hook resets against the active preset baseline and never touches atoms outside it. Structurally the deeper cure is L-6: the pane owns its config outright, so there is no externally-owned atom inside the object it resets.

defects.defect: Two implementations of 'derive the blob palette from the live colour' are alive; the one in the boot composable is dead code whose output is never rendered, yet it runs once per animation frame during a colour drag.
defects.evidence: useAtmosphere.ts:384-403 vs HeroBlob.vue:117-132 — same deriveBlobPalette call, different chromaCeiling (flat 0.16 vs Math.max(0.16, seed.C)), only the HeroBlob one applies floorStops(). MEASURED divergence on the live server (scratchpad/probe/injected.mjs): INJECTED blobConfig = ["#ffbde0","#ffdde5","#fff6f6","#fff6f4"] vs DELIVERED to <Blob> = ["#c384a6","#c3a4ab","#c4bbbb","#c4bbb9"]. The boot value's only reader is HeroBlob.vue:79 (`shallowRef([...appBlobConfig.color.paletteStops])`), superseded in the same setup tick by the {immediate:true} watch at HeroBlob.vue:132. COST measured with scratchpad/probe/bench-derive.mjs (Node 24, 20 000 iterations): `deriveBlobPalette+hex per call: 50.98 us   total 1019.6 ms for 20000`. demo/color-session/useAtmosphereFrameCoalesce.ts:10-14 names 'the blob-palette derive (both in useAtmosphere)' as one of three heavy derives it exists to coalesce — the coalescer is protecting a computation nobody consumes.
defects.mechanism: Duplicated semantic ownership: one concept, two homes, no single owner. The winner is chosen implicitly by which object the renderer happens to receive.
defects.reproduction: `node scratchpad/probe/injected.mjs` (divergent stop arrays) + `node scratchpad/probe/bench-derive.mjs` (51 us/call).
defects.proposedCure: One owner. Move the derive + ink floor into demo/scenes/blob/useBlobConfig.ts (see L-6) and delete useAtmosphere.ts:384-403. That also removes useAtmosphere's imports of @mkbabb/glass-ui/blob and @mkbabb/glass-ui/color, shrinking the boot module by two edges and returning it to owning only the aurora.

defects.defect: One concept (the blob config) has three owners across three areas and no module named for it: created and provided by an app BOOT composable, written and reset by a scenes component, overridden and rendered by a picker-scene component. The pane has no stage at all, and on mobile the tuning surface and the blob are mutually exclusive.
defects.evidence: Created/provided: demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:381-382. Palette written (dead): :393. Sliders written: demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:66-82 on behalf of BlobPane. Reset: :92-94. Overridden+rendered: demo/picker/visual/HeroBlob.vue:152-178. BlobPane's only link is the undeclared runtime edge `inject(BLOB_CONFIG_KEY)!` (BlobPane.vue:17). MOBILE: demo/shell/viewSchema.ts:179-187 defines blob as {left:'color-picker', right:'blob'} and demo/shell/usePaneRouter.ts:178-185 resolves the mobile slot to desktopLeft at pane-index 0, so /#/blob opens on the Picker segment — confirmed in docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-mobile-light/blob.png (segmented control [Picker]|Blob with Picker active, no config sliders rendered) and corroborated by REPORT.md's tap-target rows: desktop /#/blob = 39 small targets, mobile /#/blob = 8, i.e. the 35 sliders are not on screen.
defects.mechanism: No module is named for the concept, so the provide site (which must be App-scoped) became the de-facto owner, and each consumer patched what it needed where it stood.
defects.reproduction: Read the six call sites above; open docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-mobile-light/blob.png — the route named 'blob' shows no blob pane.
defects.proposedCure: Greenfield lattice: demo/scenes/blob/useBlobConfig.ts = a module-scoped `reactive(structuredClone(BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS))` + the ONE deriveBlobPalette+ink-floor owner + `BLOB_PRESETS: ConfiguratorPreset<BlobConfig>[]`, importing @mkbabb/glass-ui/blob-config only; demo/scenes/blob/BlobStudio.vue = <Configurator> with a #stage <Blob> driven by useConfiguratorState; HeroBlob imports useBlobConfig and selects the 'hero' preset. A module singleton is the idiomatic Vue 3.5 shape for app-wide state with two known consumers — it kills the provide/inject, the boot coupling, the `!` assertion, L-1, L-3 and L-4 in one move.

defects.defect: BlobPane and useAtmosphere import three config symbols through @mkbabb/glass-ui/blob — the 103 KB WebGL renderer barrel — when glass-ui publishes a 245-byte ./blob-config subpath that exports exactly those symbols and nothing else. A slider pane declares a dependency on a WebGL2 renderer.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/blob/BlobPane.vue:12-13 and demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:36. `ls -la node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/blob{,-config}.js` → 103031 bytes vs 245 bytes. blob-config.js exports BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS, BLOB_CONFIG_KEY, BLOB_HERO, LIGHTNESS_FLOOR_BRACKET, LIGHTNESS_FLOOR_DEFAULT, clampLightnessFloor; blob-config.d.ts re-exports the BlobConfig type. `grep -rn 'glass-ui/blob-config' demo src test e2e` → ZERO hits repo-wide. NEGATIVE PROOF on cost, recorded honestly: two identical entries built through the real toolchain (Vite 8/Rollup) produce `vout/a.js 0.08 kB` (via ./blob) and `vout/b.js 0.08 kB` (via ./blob-config) — byte-identical; Rollup tree-shakes the renderer away completely. esbuild (Vite's DEV pre-bundler) does not: 75892 B vs 1076 B, dev-graph only.
defects.mechanism: Wrong published-subpath edge. The producer factored a config-only entry point precisely for this consumer and the consumer ignored it, so the declared module graph says 'this pane needs a WebGL renderer' when it needs two constants and a type.
defects.reproduction: `cat node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/blob-config.js` (245 bytes, exports exactly what BlobPane imports); `grep -rn 'glass-ui/blob-config' demo src test e2e` returns nothing. Bundle probe: scratchpad/probe/vite.probe.ts.
defects.proposedCure: Change both import sites to `@mkbabb/glass-ui/blob-config`. This also puts BLOB_HERO in scope at zero cost, which is the enabler for L-1's preset cure.

defects.defect: demo/ui/ is 19 directories of pure re-export barrels aliasing @mkbabb/glass-ui, 18 of them through the ROOT barrel although glass-ui publishes 74 per-component subpaths. Three parallel idioms for reaching one dependency are live across the demo, and ConfigSliderPane uses four of them in eight consecutive lines.
defects.evidence: `for f in demo/ui/*/index.ts` shows every file is one re-export line, e.g. demo/ui/button/index.ts = `export { Button } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`. Only demo/ui/input uses a subpath (/forms). glass-ui package.json has 74 exports keys including ./button ./card ./slider ./dock ./configurator ./blob-config. Repo-wide counts: root-barrel imports 37, subpath imports 82, demo/ui shim imports 87. demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:16-23 mixes all four idioms: ../ui/button, ../ui/card, ../ui/slider (shim→root barrel), @mkbabb/glass-ui/dock, @mkbabb/glass-ui/configurator (subpaths), @mkbabb/glass-ui (root barrel, for writeClipboard). NEGATIVE PROOF on cost: Rollup builds of the same four symbols via root barrel vs via subpaths produce `vout2/root.js 0.15 kB` and `vout2/sub.js 0.15 kB` — identical. No perf defect; purely structural.
defects.mechanism: Legacy migration shim: the shadcn-vue directory shape survived the glass-ui migration as an alias layer, creating a permanent dual path (owner edict 2 forbids aliases/dual paths; edict 4 says reach for glass-ui directly).
defects.reproduction: `for f in demo/ui/*/index.ts; do printf '%-28s %s\n' "$f" "$(tr -d '\n' < $f | cut -c1-90)"; done` — 19 one-line re-exports. Bundle probe: scratchpad/probe/vite.probe2.ts.
defects.proposedCure: Delete demo/ui/ (19 dirs, 19 files) and rewrite the 87 import sites to the glass-ui subpath that already exists for each symbol. Mechanical, one commit, no behaviour change (proved by the identical bundles).

defects.defect: ConfigSliderPane styles the design system's ConfiguratorRow from outside via three :deep() rules bound to the producer's INTERNAL class names, when ConfiguratorRow ships a size axis intended for exactly this.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:204-206 (`:deep(.configurator-row .font-mono){color:...}`), :215-217 (`:deep(.configurator-row){min-block-size:clamp(2rem,7cqi,2.625rem)}`), :218-230 (a `::before` hit-area injected on `:deep(.configurator-row .glass-slider)`). ConfiguratorRow.vue.d.ts documents a three-rung `size: sm|md|lg` prop resolved local-prop-over-CONFIGURATOR_SIZE_KEY-inject, added 'so consumers can compose configurators without re-rolling the row layout'. By contrast line 202's `--slider-track-bg` feed is CORRECT — a custom-property handoff, not a selector reach.
defects.mechanism: Per-instance override of a design-system component instead of styling at its root / using its published density axis (owner edict 5). Binding to .font-mono and .glass-slider means any producer refactor breaks the demo silently, with no typecheck and no test.
defects.reproduction: Read demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:204-230 against node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/configurator/ConfiguratorRow.vue.d.ts (the `size` prop + its resolution-order doc).
defects.proposedCure: Use `size="sm"` on <Configurator> (it cascades to every row) for the density; move the muted-ink readout colour and the coarse-pointer hit-area extension into glass-ui as ConfiguratorRow behaviour — they are design-system concerns, not this pane's. Keep the --slider-track-bg token feed as the model for any remaining handoff.

defects.defect: The 33-line NumericAtomPath mapped-type guard lives in BlobPane rather than in the contract, so the sibling consumer of the same component has none — and both consumers then discard the safety at the prop boundary with a double cast through `unknown`.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/blob/BlobPane.vue:36-52 defines NumericAtomPath; demo/scenes/atmosphere/AuroraPane.vue:101-103 passes raw string keys (`{ key: "colorEnergy", ... }`, `{ key: "zones.count", ... }`) with no equivalent guard. Both then cast: BlobPane.vue:124 `:config="(cfg as unknown) as Record<string, unknown>"` and :126 `:defaults="(BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS as unknown) as Record<string, unknown>"`; AuroraPane.vue:111,113 identically. ConfigSliderPane's props are typed `Record<string, unknown>` (ConfigSliderPane.vue:41-52).
defects.mechanism: The contract is enforced at the caller instead of by the contract. A double cast through `unknown` is TypeScript's strongest 'the types are wrong here' signal and it appears twice in a 130-line file.
defects.reproduction: Compare BlobPane.vue:36-52 + :124-126 against AuroraPane.vue:97-106 + :111-113 — same component, asymmetric safety, both casts present.
defects.proposedCure: Vue 3.5 generic component: `<script setup lang="ts" generic="T extends object">` on the configurator, with `SliderDef<T> { key: NumericPath<T>; ... }`, `config: T`, `defaults: T`. The mapped type moves into the shared module ONCE, both consumers get identical safety, both double casts disappear, and readPath/writePath become the only untyped surface, contained to ~15 lines.

defects.defect: The shared contract types SliderDef and SliderSection are exported from inside a .vue SFC's <script setup>, so a consumer that needs only the types must depend on the component.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:27-39 (`export interface SliderDef`, `export interface SliderSection` inside <script setup lang="ts">); imported at demo/scenes/blob/BlobPane.vue:15 and demo/scenes/atmosphere/AuroraPane.vue:34 as `import type { SliderSection } from "../ConfigSliderPane.vue"`.
defects.mechanism: Type-only export from <script setup> is a Vue-compiler affordance, not a module boundary. A data shape with two independent consumers wants a .ts module.
defects.reproduction: Read demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:25-39 and the two `import type ... from "...ConfigSliderPane.vue"` sites.
defects.proposedCure: Under the L-6 lattice these types cease to exist (ConfiguratorPreset/ConfiguratorRow props replace them). If ConfigSliderPane were kept, they belong in demo/scenes/config-pane/types.ts.

defects.defect: writePath cannot create missing intermediate objects and will throw where readPath safely returns undefined — an asymmetry inside one file, exposed for the sibling consumer whose path segment is typed optional.
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:57-64 (readPath guards `if (cur == null || typeof cur !== "object") return undefined`) vs :66-73 (writePath walks unguarded then assigns `cur[segs[segs.length-1]!] = value`). AuroraPane.vue:74 reads `atoms.zones?.count ?? 4` as OPTIONAL while AuroraPane.vue:103 writes the path `zones.count` unconditionally. BlobPane is protected by NumericAtomPath; AuroraPane is not.
defects.mechanism: Read/write asymmetry in a stringly-typed reflection layer that lives inside a component instead of a tested module.
defects.reproduction: NONE — this is a HYPOTHESIS. DEFAULT_AURORA_ATOMS currently defines `zones`, so the throw is latent, not live.
defects.proposedCure: Under L-10's generic-component cure the path type makes the intermediate provably present. Failing that, writePath must guard and either create the intermediate or refuse, matching readPath.

defects.defect: A global class consumed by nine sibling panes is defined in an unscoped <style> block inside an unrelated leaf component.
defects.evidence: demo/shared/ui/PaneHeader.vue:44-59 defines `.pane-scroll-fade` in an UNSCOPED <style> block; its own comment concedes the class 'is applied across siblings of PaneHeader (not its descendants)' and lists nine consumers. demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:106 is one of them.
defects.mechanism: Global CSS owned by a leaf component whose consumers are not in its subtree; global classes and keyframes belong in demo/styles/.

defects.defect: The slider tracks paint the app's grey no-signal fallback permanently, the declared spectrum variant is defeated per-instance, and the range paints nothing — so 31 tracks carry zero value information
defects.evidence: demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:202 sets --slider-track-bg: var(--ink-muted, var(--muted-foreground)). Measured live: the only painted element in the whole .glass-slider subtree is .slider-track at oklch(0.447121 0.00386159 34.63) — chroma 0.0039, achromatic — on a well of oklab(0.913295 0.0055 0.0130); .slider-range ('slider-range glass-liquid-fill') has transparent background and no image. sliderVariant reads "spectrum" live (ConfigSliderPane.vue:146 passes variant="spectrum"). --ink-muted is used as `color:` at ExtractWorkbench.vue:291, ImageDropZone.vue:110, ExtractControls.vue:149; ConfigSliderPane.vue:202 is the ONLY site painting it as a background. ExtractControls.vue:124 shows the correct idiom: cssColor ? safeCss(cssColor, GRAPHICS_CONTRAST_FLOOR) : "var(--ink-muted)" — chromatic when a live pick threads, grey only otherwise. Visual: shots/safari-desktop-light/blob.png (seven near-black slabs) vs shots/safari-desktop-dark/blob.png (the same rule inverts to seven near-white slabs that are the brightest ink on the page).
defects.mechanism: Fallback-as-material — a certified de-emphasis TEXT token used as a FILL, producing the pane's dominant optical mass in both schemes (inverted hierarchy), plus a per-instance custom-property override that defeats the variant the same component requests (owner edict 5). Because the range is the element that would show where the value sits, the value signal collapses to a 12px hollow thumb and an 11px number. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5 requires 'a color-bearing or neutral track chosen by semantics' — the Color section's hueRange/satShift/brightnessShift rows are grey in the same frame where the Picker's Lab channels are full spectral ramps.
defects.reproduction: node .../scratchpad/blobprobe2.mjs (paint census + computed styles); read the light and dark shots side by side.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the --slider-track-bg override and let the spectrum variant paint what it declares; a real .slider-range restores the value signal and the chromatic semantics. If the track's rest contrast was the original motive, cure it in the producer's spectrum recipe (a root fix per edict 5), never in a consumer custom property.

defects.defect: The live readouts violate the NORMATIVE card-lock law on both required mechanisms — no tabular figures and no worst-case ch reservation — and the formatter swings the value between 1 and 6 characters mid-drag
defects.evidence: demo/DESIGN.md:60-79 (NORMATIVE, R.W3 Lane A / A6, U31): 'a value change may never move the card ... Two mechanisms, both required ... 1. Tabular figures ... 2. ch worst-case reservation'. Measured across all 31 readouts: readoutFVN ["normal"], readoutMinW [auto], rendered widths "3" -> 6.8px vs "0.220" -> 33.9px (a 27.1px swing in one column). Every other live-number surface declares it: ComponentSliders.vue:311, ColorComponentDisplay.vue:147, ExtractControls.vue:15,78, GenerateControls.vue:212,288, AdminAuditPanel.vue:70, PaginationBar.vue:17. ConfigSliderPane.vue:84-86 fmt = Number.isInteger(v) ? String(v) : v.toFixed(3); swept over BlobPane's declared triples: tempo char-widths 1/5 ("1.900"->"1.950"->"2"->"2.050"), membrane.noiseFreq 1/2/5 ("4.800"->"4.900"->"5"->"5.100"), interaction.pointerAttraction 1/2/5/6, plus specStrength / rimPower / stretch / pulseFreq / colorNoiseFreq all 1/5.
defects.mechanism: The generic pane never gave SliderDef a `precision` or `unit`, so a single heuristic formatter serves 31 heterogeneous domains and flips the number's apparent KIND at every integer crossing; combined with no tabular figures and min-width:auto, the readout re-flows instead of re-inking. Also violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4 ('Live numbers use tabular figures and reserve their widest legal representation so value changes never reflow the settled chassis').

defects.proposedCure: Carry `unit` and `precision` on SliderDef in the successor row contract, declare font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, reserve max-legal-ch per definition, and promote the value from text-micro to text-mono-small.

defects.defect: 17 of the config's 48 axes are unreachable from the pane — including morphT (the sole flat<->dressed axis), surface.lit (the 'Lit Glass' section's own master switch), rimColor, lightDir and membrane.merge — and the type guard that claims to prevent silent no-ops cannot detect any of it
defects.evidence: Census against the installed @mkbabb/glass-ui@7.0.0 BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS: 48 leaves total, 39 numeric, 31 pane sliders. NUMERIC ATOMS WITH NO SLIDER (8): geometry.canvasSize, color.lightnessFloor, surface.shadowSoftness, surface.iridHue, surface.iridSpeed, surface.sssPower, surface.fissionAmp, morphT. NON-NUMERIC AXES WITH NO CONTROL (9): satellites.absorbedDuration, satellites.orbitDuration, membrane.merge, color.paletteStops, surface.lit, surface.shadow, surface.rimColor, surface.lightDir, quality. Defaults: morphT=1, surface.lit=true, quality="full". types.d.ts calls morphT 'The sole flat<->dressed surface axis'. ConfigSliderPane.vue:12-14 documents that AuroraPane drives the default slot with enum Select rows; BlobPane.vue:122-130 passes no slot content.
defects.mechanism: The NumericAtomPath guard at BlobPane.vue:36-48 is an exhaustiveness guard pointed the wrong way — it proves every key given exists, never that every key that exists is given; and the narrowing is discarded at the boundary anyway (s() returns {key: NumericAtomPath,...} assigned into SliderSection[] whose SliderDef.key is `string`, ConfigSliderPane.vue:28), so no exhaustiveness check is even expressible. 26 of the file's 130 lines (20%) defend that guard. Result: 'Lit Glass' is a half-instrument — every atom is a magnitude whose direction or hue is missing (iridescence without iridHue/iridSpeed, sssScale without sssPower, specular without lightDir, rim strength/power without rimColor).

defects.proposedCure: Once <ConfiguratorLayer> supplies real sections, the 17 axes have somewhere to live: morphT as the headline essential; lit/shadow/quality as switches; membrane.merge as a Select (the mechanism AuroraPane already uses through the same slot); rimColor as a colour control — in a colour tool; lightDir via the producer's `axes` surface.

defects.defect: 'Copy JSON' is a one-way dump of a 48-leaf superset the pane cannot edit, with no import counterpart and no success/failure surface
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:88-90: async function copyAsJson() { await writeClipboard(JSON.stringify(config, null, 2)); }. defects.mechanism: The pane's edit model and its export model are different objects, and the action has no commit half. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5: 'Persistent operation state stays with the entity/workspace ... never carries the only truth' — here nothing carries it.
