defects.defect: 'Reset' discards 31 tuned values with no confirmation, no undo and no dirty state, and is rendered at identical weight adjacent to the benign 'Copy JSON'
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:92-94: Object.assign(config, structuredClone(defaults)). Both buttons are variant="ghost" size="sm" inside one GlassDock (lines 164-173). glass-ui 7.0.0 ships useConfiguratorState with isDirty + resetCurrent (dist/components/configurator/useConfiguratorState.d.ts) and the header comment at ConfigSliderPane.vue:6-10 names it without calling it, so the pane cannot even tell the user there is anything to lose.
defects.mechanism: A destructive verb and a benign one given the same visual weight and no state; the producer's dirty/reset surface was named and declined.
defects.reproduction: NONE — static reading plus the producer d.ts. Design-contract finding.
defects.proposedCure: Adopt useConfiguratorState<BlobConfig> for isDirty/resetCurrent and differentiate the destructive action per VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5's one-action-set rule.

defects.defect: The pane description restates four of the seven section headers rendered immediately below it
defects.evidence: BlobPane.vue:128 description="Tune metaball geometry, membrane, lit-glass surface, and satellite behavior." Rendered section headers (live census): Geometry, Membrane, Color, Lit Glass, Pointer, Satellites, Tempo. In shots/safari-desktop-light/blob.png the sentence wraps to two lines directly above the words it repeats.
defects.mechanism: Explanation standing in for structure. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 law 6: 'Subtraction precedes explanation.'
defects.reproduction: NONE — read BlobPane.vue:128 against the rendered headers in shots/safari-desktop-light/blob.png.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the description; the section layers name their own content.

defects.defect: A dead type modifier defended by a comment that misstates the installed dependency's shape
defects.evidence: BlobPane.vue:28-29 justifies the OUTER `-?` on the grounds that 'BlobConfig.morphT? is a top-level optional number'. node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/blob/types.d.ts declares `morphT: number;` — REQUIRED — and no top-level member of BlobConfig is optional (geometry, satellites, membrane, color, surface, interaction, morphT, quality, tempo). The outer -? is therefore a no-op. The INNER -? remains load-bearing (color.lightnessFloor?, color.satelliteColors?).
defects.mechanism: Comment drift against a producer major (glass-ui 7.0.0) — the documentation asserts a dependency shape that no longer exists, in the same 26-line block that justifies 20% of the file.
defects.reproduction: cat node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/blob/types.d.ts | grep -n 'morphT'
defects.proposedCure: Drop the outer -? and the paragraph defending it; the inner strip keeps its real, still-current justification.

defects.defect: The empty-state branch is a second code path with no caller
defects.evidence: ConfigSliderPane.vue:44 documents 'Pass empty array to show empty state'; lines 118-121 and 163 gate the slider block and the action bar on sections.length > 0. BlobPane.vue:54-119 always passes 7 populated sections; AuroraPane likewise. The branch renders a header alone in a full-height Card and is never reached.
defects.mechanism: Dead alternate path in a generic component (owner edict 2 — no dual paths).
defects.reproduction: NONE — static reading; grep for any caller passing sections: [] returns none.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the branch when the pane is transposed onto <Configurator>; a workbench with no controls is not a state this product has.

defects.defect: Slider geometry does not mirror under dir=rtl
defects.evidence: shots/rtl-desktop/blob.png: 'Body Radius 0.220' (min 0.08, max 0.45 => 37.8% of range) places the thumb ~38% from the LEFT of the track under RTL; 'Sat Radius 0.082' (34.4% of range) sits at ~34.9% from the left. The Picker's L channel in the same frame (92.0%) sits at ~91% from the left. Also visible: the description renders '...and satellite\n.behavior' — a neutral-character bidi artifact.
defects.mechanism: Inherited from the shared Slider primitive, NOT BlobPane-specific — the Picker channels fail identically in the same capture, so this is a design-system-level row, not this component's seat.
defects.reproduction: Read docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/rtl-desktop/blob.png and compare the config-console thumb positions against the declared min/max/value triples in BlobPane.vue:58-61.
defects.proposedCure: Route to the shared Slider primitive owner; VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5.2 already rules the key semantics ('numeric/scientific sign never mirrors') but the rendered track geometry must follow the document direction per §6.1.
